en: run native ARM code on the console through CLI_RUN_BUFFER_SCRIPT instead of sending a gift: trainer-id-probe: read playerTrainerId out of gSaveBlock2Ptr and return it (reads only, writes nothing); save-dump: read out any part of either save block, using the pointers the console hands us - no absolute address needed (reads only, writes nothing); memory-dump: read out any region of the console's memory by repointing the console's own outgoing message at it (needs --dump-address; reads only, writes nothing); memory-dump-multi: the same, but SEVERAL consecutive blocks in one session (--dump-address --dump-blocks N): the client script runs the payload once per block and each pass sends the next kilobyte; memory-dump-scatter: the same, but the blocks are UNRELATED addresses (--dump-scatter A,B,C): the payload carries a table of bases and the cursor indexes it, so one session reads the sixteen kilobytes a plan actually asked for rather than sixteen consecutive ones; save-write: write bytes into a save block and read the same region back in the same run; the console saves afterwards, so the write reaches flash (--write-hex, --dump-block, --dump-offset); rng-trace: sample one word of memory once a frame, optionally calling a ROM function between the two halves of each sample, and check the LCG recurrence on what comes back (--trace-address, --trace-call, --trace-samples; reads only, plus whatever the callee does); memory-scan: search memory for a 32-bit value and send back where it is; it returns 0 to be called again next frame, so one run covers a range no dump could (--scan-word, --scan-start, --scan-end, --scan-blocks; reads only, writes nothing); table-scan: search memory for a table by its shape, a run of N words each exactly D above the one before it, and send back where each run starts and what value it starts with; this is how a table of pointers is found when no constant in it is known (--table-delta, --table-runlen, --table-start, --table-end, --table-blocks; reads only, writes nothing); rom-checksum: checksum a range of memory in up to 128 blocks and send back one sum per block; the host sets them beside the same sums over a ROM image and names the blocks that differ (--sum-start, --sum-end, --sum-block, --sum-budget, --sum-reference; reads only, writes nothing); anchors: ask the machine where it is: our own load address, the return address into ROM, the stack and the client's five buffers (writes only its own outgoing buffer); create-mon: call CreateMon, a ROM function taking eight arguments, and send back the 100-byte struct Pokemon it built; the mon is built inside our own image, so nothing on the console is written unless --create-mon-append or --create-mon-destination asks for it (--create-mon-call, --create-mon-species, --create-mon-level, --create-mon-personality); string-gather: follow an array of pointers and send back the strings themselves, back to back, instead of a window of mostly-pointers: a whole Easy Chat group in one run (--gather-address, --gather-count, --gather-stride; reads only, writes nothing); call: call any ROM function with arguments we choose, up to eight words in r0..r3 then the stack, and send back its r0 with one address read either side of the call (--call-address, --call-arg, --call-watch); the payload writes nothing itself, but the callee may, so the address has to have been read as code first; flash-read: select the flash bank, byte-copy a save sector out of the 64 KiB window into EWRAM with the CPU, and send the COPY: the console's outgoing message cannot be pointed at flash itself (--flash-sector, --flash-read-offset, --dump-size; reads only, writes nothing); flash-patch: read a save sector out of flash through the banked window, change one field, recompute the checksum and write it back with swi 0x48, then bump the counter-bearing sector so the loader adopts the band. Nothing is rebuilt from RAM, so a field the save routine serializes cannot be lost (--flash-id, --flash-patch-offset, --flash-patch-hex; needs --write-unsafe); flash-write: compose 4 KB in EWRAM on the console and write it straight into a flash sector with swi 0x48, instead of going through the game's save code entirely - no counter, checksum or signature (--flash-sector, --flash-fill-base, --flash-fill-step, --flash-words; a sector inside the save bands needs --write-unsafe); call-chain: run a LIST of ROM calls and memory accesses in one frame and send back a word for each, any step able to use the previous step's result as its address - which is how a function that returns a pointer (GetVarPointer) becomes a write (--chain-step, repeatable; a write step needs --write-unsafe); sloop-svc: issue one Sloop syscall (swi 0x40..0x62) with r0..r3 we choose, optionally pointing r0 or r1 at up to 256 bytes we send, and send back the registers and the bytes as the syscall left them (--svc-number, --svc-arg, --svc-text/--svc-hex, --svc-data-in; a number outside the read-only set needs --write-unsafe); install-resident: copy a resident hook into the top of EWRAM and install it in gIntrTable[4], where it runs every frame until a soft reset; answers with the V-blank handler it found (--resident turbo, --resident-param extra=N field=N battle=N hold=0x100 budget=228; needs --write-unsafe); install-kept: install the resident hook kept in the save's filler_B20 (written by save-write --resident), after checking its sum; answers with the V-blank handler it found, 0xBAD0BAD0 when nothing was installed; rom-reset-probe: write a 4 KB pattern into the ROM copy at 0x08000000 + n * 0x1000 through the swi 0x48 fold, then GBA-soft-reset, to settle whether a ROM-copy write survives a soft reset. A second Mystery Gift session dumps the address (--rom-fold-n, --rom-fill-base; needs --write-unsafe)
zh_Hans: 通过 CLI_RUN_BUFFER_SCRIPT 在主机上运行原生 ARM 代码，而不是发送礼物：trainer-id-probe：从 gSaveBlock2Ptr 读出 playerTrainerId 并返回（只读，不写入任何内容）；save-dump：利用主机交给我们的指针读出两个存档块中任意一块的任意部分，无需绝对地址（只读，不写入任何内容）；memory-dump：把主机自己的外发消息重新指向目标，从而读出主机内存的任意区域（需要 --dump-address；只读，不写入任何内容）；memory-dump-multi：同上，但在一次会话中读取若干个连续块（--dump-address --dump-blocks N）：客户端脚本对每个块运行一次载荷，每一轮发送下一个千字节；memory-dump-scatter：同上，但各块是互不相关的地址（--dump-scatter A,B,C）：载荷携带一张基址表，由游标索引它，因此一次会话读的是计划真正要求的十六千字节，而不是十六个连续千字节；save-write：向存档块写入字节，并在同一次运行中读回同一区域；主机随后会存档，因此写入会落到 flash（--write-hex、--dump-block、--dump-offset）；rng-trace：每帧采样一个内存字，可在每次采样的两半之间调用一个 ROM 函数，并对返回的东西检查 LCG 递推（--trace-address、--trace-call、--trace-samples；只读，外加被调用函数自身所做的一切）；memory-scan：在内存中搜索一个 32 位值并返回它所在的位置；它返回 0 表示下一帧再被调用，因此一次运行可覆盖任何 dump 都无法覆盖的范围（--scan-word、--scan-start、--scan-end、--scan-blocks；只读，不写入任何内容）；table-scan：按形状在内存中搜索一张表，即 N 个连续的字、每个都恰好比前一个高 D，并返回每一段的起始位置及其起始值；当表中没有任何已知常量时，就是这样找到指针表的（--table-delta、--table-runlen、--table-start、--table-end、--table-blocks；只读，不写入任何内容）；rom-checksum：对一段内存做校验和，最多分 128 块，每块返回一个和；主机把它们与同一 ROM 镜像上的相同和并列比较，并指出不同的块（--sum-start、--sum-end、--sum-block、--sum-budget、--sum-reference；只读，不写入任何内容）；anchors：向机器询问它在哪里：我们自己的加载地址、返回 ROM 的返回地址、栈，以及客户端的五个缓冲区（只写它自己的外发缓冲区）；create-mon：调用 CreateMon，一个接收八个参数的 ROM 函数，并返回它构建的 100 字节 struct Pokemon；宝可梦构建在我们自己的镜像内，因此除非 --create-mon-append 或 --create-mon-destination 要求，主机上不会被写入任何内容（--create-mon-call、--create-mon-species、--create-mon-level、--create-mon-personality）；string-gather：跟随一个指针数组并把字符串本身连续发回，而不是发回一个大多是指针的窗口：一次运行取回整个 Easy Chat 组（--gather-address、--gather-count、--gather-stride；只读，不写入任何内容）；call：以我们选定的参数调用任意 ROM 函数，最多八个字，先放 r0..r3 再放栈，并返回其 r0，同时在调用两侧各读一个地址（--call-address、--call-arg、--call-watch）；载荷本身不写入任何内容，但被调用函数可能会写，因此该地址必须已先作为代码读过；flash-read：选择 flash bank，用 CPU 从 64 KiB 窗口中按字节复制一个存档扇区到 EWRAM，并发送这份副本：主机的外发消息无法直接指向 flash 本身（--flash-sector、--flash-read-offset、--dump-size；只读，不写入任何内容）；flash-patch：通过分 bank 的窗口从 flash 读出一个存档扇区，修改一个字段，重算校验和并用 swi 0x48 写回，然后递增带计数器的扇区，好让加载器采用该 band。不从 RAM 重建任何东西，因此存档例程会序列化的字段不会丢失（--flash-id、--flash-patch-offset、--flash-patch-hex；需要 --write-unsafe）；flash-write：在主机上的 EWRAM 中拼出 4 KB，并用 swi 0x48 直接写入一个 flash 扇区，完全绕开游戏的存档代码 - 没有计数器、校验和或签名（--flash-sector、--flash-fill-base、--flash-fill-step、--flash-words；位于存档 band 内的扇区需要 --write-unsafe）；call-chain：在一帧内运行一组 ROM 调用和内存访问，并为每一步返回一个字，任何一步都可以把上一步的结果用作自己的地址 - 这正是让返回指针的函数（GetVarPointer）变成一次写入的方式（--chain-step，可重复；写入步骤需要 --write-unsafe）；sloop-svc：以我们选定的 r0..r3 发出一个 Sloop 系统调用（swi 0x40..0x62），可选地把 r0 或 r1 指向我们发送的最多 256 字节，并按系统调用留下的状态返回寄存器和这些字节（--svc-number、--svc-arg、--svc-text/--svc-hex、--svc-data-in；只读集合之外的编号需要 --write-unsafe）；install-resident：把一个常驻钩子复制到 EWRAM 顶部并安装到 gIntrTable[4]，它会在那里每帧运行，直到软复位；返回它找到的 V-blank 处理程序（--resident turbo，--resident-param extra=N field=N battle=N hold=0x100 budget=228；需要 --write-unsafe）；install-kept：在检查校验和后，安装保存在存档 filler_B20 中的常驻钩子（由 save-write --resident 写入）；返回它找到的 V-blank 处理程序，未安装任何东西时返回 0xBAD0BAD0；rom-reset-probe：通过 swi 0x48 折叠把 4 KB 模式写入 0x08000000 + n * 0x1000 处的 ROM 副本，然后做 GBA 软复位，以确定 ROM 副本的写入能否经受软复位。第二次神秘礼物会话会 dump 该地址（--rom-fold-n、--rom-fill-base；需要 --write-unsafe）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script string-gather：要跟随的数组中第一个指针的地址。返回结果就是这些字符串本身，首尾相接，因此一次运行能带回整张表，而不是一个主要由指针组成的窗口。接受 0x 十六进制
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script string-gather: how many pointers to follow at most
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script string-gather：最多跟随多少个指针
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script string-gather: bytes from one pointer to the next (default 12, struct EasyChatWordInfo, whose `text` is at offset 0; a plain array of `const u8 *` is 4)
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script string-gather：从一个指针到下一个指针的字节数（默认 12，即 struct EasyChatWordInfo，其 `text` 位于偏移 0；纯 `const u8 *` 数组则为 4）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script string-gather：可接受的最长字符串，含终止符。否则并非字符串的指针会被一直复制到遇上 0xFF 为止（默认 64）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script rng-trace：每帧采样一次的字。gRngValue 在法文卡带上为 0x03004220，在英文卡带上为 0x030042D0 [builds.py]。接受 0x 十六进制
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script rng-trace: a ROM function to call between the two reads of each sample, as a THUMB pointer (bit 0 set), or 0 for none. Random is 0x080486B1 French, 0x08048671 English; the recurrence between the two reads is then the proof that both addresses are what we say they are
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script rng-trace：在每个样本的两次读取之间调用的 ROM 函数，以 THUMB 指针给出（bit 0 置位），0 表示不调用。Random 在法文版是 0x080486B1，英文版是 0x08048671；两次读取之间的递推关系便是这两个地址确如我们所言的证据
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script rng-trace: how many frames to sample, 1..96
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script rng-trace：采样多少帧，1..96
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script call: the ROM function to call, as a THUMB pointer (bit 0 set). SeedRng is 0x080486D1 and Random 0x080486B1 on the French cartridges, 0x08048691 and 0x08048671 on the English ones [builds.py]. The address is sent as given, so pair it with --console-build. 0 calls nothing, which checks the send path with the ROM left out
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script call：要调用的 ROM 函数，以 THUMB 指针给出（bit 0 置位）。在法文卡带上 SeedRng 为 0x080486D1、Random 为 0x080486B1，在英文卡带上分别为 0x08048691 和 0x08048671 [builds.py]。地址按原样发送，所以要配合 --console-build 使用。0 表示不调用任何函数，用于在不涉及 ROM 的情况下检查发送路径
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script call: one argument word, repeatable, up to eight. The first four go in r0..r3 and the rest on the stack at [sp+0..12], where CreateMon's own prologue reads them
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script call：一个参数字，可重复，最多八个。前四个放入 r0..r3，其余放在栈上的 [sp+0..12]，CreateMon 自身的序言会从那里读取它们
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script call: one word read immediately before and immediately after the call, both returned. gRngValue is 0x03004220 French, 0x030042D0 English. For a function that returns nothing, such as SeedRng, this is the only evidence the call did what it was called for
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script call：一个在调用前和调用后各立即读取一次的字，两次都会返回。gRngValue 在法文版是 0x03004220，英文版是 0x030042D0。对于不返回任何值的函数（例如 SeedRng），这是该调用确实达到了调用目的的唯一证据
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: refuse the session unless the console that joins is this cartridge, checked against the version in its game data. Nothing is sent on a mismatch
zh_Hans: 除非加入的实机是这张卡带，否则拒绝该会话，并对照其游戏数据中的版本进行检查。不匹配时不发送任何内容
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: whose addresses a hook, a stub or a ROM call is built with: BPRF, BPGF, BPRE, BPGE, BPRS, BPGS, BPRD, BPGD, BPRI, BPGI, BPRJ, BPGJ. auto (the default) builds for each and sends the one the console's game code names, before anything address-dependent is sent; another code is refused. A game code serves only that cartridge. Bytes with no build address go to any console either way
zh_Hans: hook、stub 或 ROM 调用按哪个游戏代号构建地址：BPRF、BPGF、BPRE、BPGE、BPRS、BPGS、BPRD、BPGD、BPRI、BPGI、BPRJ、BPGJ。auto（默认）会为每个代号构建，并在发送任何依赖地址的内容之前，发送主机游戏代码所指明的那个；其他代号会被拒绝。一个游戏代码只服务于对应卡带。没有构建地址的字节无论如何都会发往任何主机
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script call-chain: one step, repeatable, up to 16, run in order in one frame. `call:NAME_OR_ADDR[,ARG]...` calls a ROM function (AddBagItem, AddMoney, AddPCItem, CalcCRC16, CheckBagHasItem, CheckBagHasSpace, CompactPartySlots, CreateMon, FlagClear, FlagGet, FlagSet, GetMoney, GetSetPokedexFlag, GetVarPointer, IncrementGameStat, InitRamScript, IsEnoughMoney, ItemIsMail, Random, ReadFlash, RemoveBagItem, RemoveMoney, RunScriptImmediately, SeedRng, SpeciesToNationalPokedexNum, StringCompare, VarGet, VarSet, or a THUMB address); `read32|read16|read8:ADDR` reads; `write32|write16|write8:ADDR,VALUE` writes and reads itself back, and needs --write-unsafe. A target of `prev` is the PREVIOUS step's result and `prev+N` is N bytes past it, which is how a function that returns a pointer becomes a write; an op may carry +keep to leave prev alone. Example: --chain-step call:GetVarPointer,0x4024 --chain-step write16:prev,7. A named function is resolved on the console's build
zh_Hans: --buffer-script call-chain：一个步骤，可重复，最多 16 个，在一帧内按顺序执行。`call:NAME_OR_ADDR[,ARG]...` 调用 ROM 函数（AddBagItem、AddMoney、AddPCItem、CalcCRC16、CheckBagHasItem、CheckBagHasSpace、CompactPartySlots、CreateMon、FlagClear、FlagGet、FlagSet、GetMoney、GetSetPokedexFlag、GetVarPointer、IncrementGameStat、InitRamScript、IsEnoughMoney、ItemIsMail、Random、ReadFlash、RemoveBagItem、RemoveMoney、RunScriptImmediately、SeedRng、SpeciesToNationalPokedexNum、StringCompare、VarGet、VarSet，或一个 THUMB 地址）；`read32|read16|read8:ADDR` 读取；`write32|write16|write8:ADDR,VALUE` 写入并回读自身，且需要 --write-unsafe。目标为 `prev` 表示上一步的结果，`prev+N` 表示其后 N 字节，这正是把返回指针的函数变成写入的方式；一个操作可带 +keep 以保持 prev 不变。示例：--chain-step call:GetVarPointer,0x4024 --chain-step write16:prev,7。具名函数会在主机的构建版本上解析
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: the ROM function to call with eight arguments, a THUMB pointer. The default is the console build's CreateMon (0x08041151 French, 0x080411FD English); 0 calls nothing, which checks the send path with the ROM left out
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：以八个参数调用的 ROM 函数，THUMB 指针。默认是主机版本的 CreateMon（法文版 0x08041151，英文版 0x080411FD）；0 表示不调用任何函数，用于在不涉及 ROM 的情况下检查发送路径
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: the species number, 1..411 (internal numbering, not the National Dex)
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：宝可梦编号，1..411（内部编号，不是全国图鉴编号）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: the level, 1..100
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：等级，1..100
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: every IV set to this, 0..31. 32 or more rolls them instead [USE_RANDOM_IVS], which makes the run non-deterministic
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：所有个体值都设为这个值，0..31。32 或更大则改为随机生成 [USE_RANDOM_IVS]，这会使运行结果不确定
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：32 位性格值，它决定性格、性别、特性槽，并与训练家 ID 一起决定宝可梦是否异色。省略时，主机用 Random32 随机生成一个
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：0 = 初训家是玩家，ID 取自真实存档；1 = 使用 --create-mon-ot-id；2 = 反复随机直到不是异色
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon --create-mon-ot-id-type 1: the OT id to use
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon --create-mon-ot-id-type 1：要使用的初训家 ID
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: append the finished mon to the player's party. The slot is computed from gSaveBlock1Ptr, never given, and it is always the first free one - playerParty[playerPartyCount] - so an occupied slot is never touched and no Pokemon can be destroyed. A full party writes nothing and says so. This is the player's live SAVE and the console commits it to flash: needs --write-unsafe
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：把生成的宝可梦追加到玩家的队伍。槽位由 gSaveBlock1Ptr 计算得出，不能直接指定，且始终是第一个空闲槽 - playerParty[playerPartyCount] - 因此绝不会碰到已占用的槽位，也不会有宝可梦被销毁。队伍已满时不写入任何内容并会说明。这是玩家的实时存档，主机会把它提交到 flash：需要 --write-unsafe
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: the same run as --create-mon-append - the same call, the same arithmetic on the same gSaveBlock1Ptr - with the two stores that would change the save left out. It reports the party count and the address it would have written, and reads that slot's current 100 bytes back so the answer says what a real run would overwrite. Writes nothing, so it needs no override
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：与 --create-mon-append 相同的运行 - 相同的调用、对同一个 gSaveBlock1Ptr 的相同运算 - 只是省略了会修改存档的两处写入。它会报告队伍数量和本应写入的地址，并读回该槽位当前的 100 字节，因此结果能说明真实运行会覆盖什么。不写入任何内容，所以不需要额外授权
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: copy the finished 100 bytes to this address in the console's memory. The mon is built in our own image either way, so without this nothing on the console is written at all. Needs --write-unsafe
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：把生成的 100 字节复制到主机内存中的这个地址。无论哪种方式，宝可梦都在我们自己的映像里构建，因此不指定它就不会向主机写入任何内容。需要 --write-unsafe
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script save-write: ascii to write into the save block at --dump-offset. The same region is read back in the same run, so the answer is the proof. The console saves afterwards, so it reaches flash
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script save-write：写入 --dump-offset 处存档块的 ASCII 内容。同一次运行中会读回同一区域，因此结果即是证明。主机会随后保存，所以内容会进入 flash
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script save-write: the bytes to write, as hex
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script save-write：要写入的字节，以十六进制给出
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script flash-write: the 4 KB flash sector (0..31) swi 0x48 writes. Sectors 0..27 are the two save bands and need --write-unsafe; 28..31 are outside both
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-write：swi 0x48 要写入的 4 KB flash 扇区（0..31）。扇区 0..27 属于两个存档区段，需要 --write-unsafe；28..31 不属于其中任何一个

en: with --buffer-script rom-reset-probe: the 4 KB block in the ROM copy to write, 0..0xFFF; the address is 0x08000000 + N * 0x1000. The payload writes a pattern there and soft-resets; needs --write-unsafe
zh_TW: 搭配 --buffer-script rom-reset-probe：指定要寫入的 ROM 副本區塊，每塊 4 KB，範圍為 0..0xFFF；位址為 0x08000000 + N * 0x1000。執行後會寫入測試樣式並進行軟重置；須加上 --write-unsafe
seed: 搭配 --buffer-script rom-reset-probe：指定要写入的 ROM 副本区块，每块 4 KB，范围为 0..0xFFF；地址为 0x08000000 + N * 0x1000。运行后会写入测试样式并进行软重置；须加上 --write-unsafe
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script rom-reset-probe：要写入的 ROM 副本区块（每块 4 KB），范围为 0..0xFFF；地址为 0x08000000 + N * 0x1000。载荷会在该处写入一段模式并进行软重启；需要 --write-unsafe

en: with --buffer-script rom-reset-probe: word[0] of the pattern (default 'EMER')
zh_TW: 搭配 --buffer-script rom-reset-probe：測試樣式的 word[0]（預設為 'EMER'）
seed: 搭配 --buffer-script rom-reset-probe：测试样式的 word[0]（默认为 'EMER'）
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script rom-reset-probe：模式的 word[0]（默认为 'EMER'）

en: with --buffer-script flash-write: word[0] of the pattern the console composes
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-write：主机所构造模式的 word[0]

en: with --buffer-script flash-write: added to each word of the pattern
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-write：加到模式的每个字上

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-write：要构造扇区的多少个字

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-write：构造一个格式正确的存档扇区，而不是原始模式 - 主机将数据之后的部分清零，对 3968 字节的数据区计算游戏自身的校验和，并写入 id、校验和、签名和计数器
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --flash-footer: the sector id written at +0xFF4
zh_Hans: 配合 --flash-footer：写入 +0xFF4 的扇区 ID
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --flash-footer: the save counter written at +0xFFC
zh_Hans: 配合 --flash-footer：写入 +0xFFC 的存档计数器

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script sloop-svc：一个系统调用，0x40..0x62（0x4D 是 bad-word 检查）；最多重复八次，在一次会话中按顺序发出

en: with --buffer-script sloop-svc: r0, r1, r2, r3 in order (repeatable)
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script sloop-svc：依次为 r0、r1、r2、r3（可重复）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script sloop-svc：要发送的 UTF-8 数据，最多 256 字节

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-read：从扇区内开始读取的字节偏移

zh_Hans: 允许写入 SaveBlock2 结构中从不读取的填充区域之外的存档内容。这是玩家的实时存档，主机会把它写入闪存；没有此选项时写入会被拒绝

en: Wonder Card flagId, 1000..1019; without this option, the selected gift's registered default shown below is used
zh_Hans: 神秘卡片 flagId，1000..1019；不使用此选项时，会采用所选礼物已注册的默认值，见下方
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en:
require the console to be holding this four-word Easy Chat phrase in its Poke Mart
questionnaire before anything is sent [SVR_CHECK_QUESTIONNAIRE]. Each word is an
English word name, `species:N`, `move:N`, `group/index`, or a raw id. Word ids are
per-language outside the species and move groups, so read the phrase off the target
console first: every session logs the four ids it is holding.
zh_Hans: 要求主机在商店问卷中持有这条四词 Easy Chat 短语后才会发送任何内容 [SVR_CHECK_QUESTIONNAIRE]。每个词是一个英文单词名、`species:N`、`move:N`、`group/index` 或原始 id。在 species 与 move 组之外，词 id 按语言区分，所以先从目标主机上读出该短语：每次会话都会记录它当前持有的四个 id。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: what a console that does not know the phrase reads (max 63 characters); the default is 'That is not the phrase.'
zh_Hans: 不认识该口令的主机所读到的内容（最多 63 个字符）；默认为 “That is not the phrase.”
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en:
with --gift rng-mon-hunt: which natures the search will accept, comma separated
(Hardy, Lonely, Brave, Adamant, Naughty, Bold, ...), or plain ids. Without this it takes any.
zh_Hans: 配合 --gift rng-mon-hunt：搜索会接受哪些性格，以逗号分隔（Hardy、Lonely、Brave、Adamant、Naughty、Bold 等），也可用纯数字 ID。不指定则接受任意性格。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en:
with --gift rng-mon-hunt: a floor under one IV, repeatable (speed=31, attack=20). The stats
are hp, attack, defense, speed, sp_attack, sp_defense, named in the order the ROM draws them - which is not the order the summary
screen shows.
zh_Hans: 配合 --gift rng-mon-hunt：某一项个体值的下限，可重复（speed=31、attack=20）。各项依次为 hp、attack、defense、speed、sp_attack、sp_defense，按 ROM 抽取它们的顺序命名 - 并非摘要界面显示的顺序。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en:
with --gift event-pokemon: a fresh copy of a Gen 3 distribution, made by PKHeX by that event's
own PID/IV method, e.g. "WISHMKR Jirachi", "10 ANIV Pikachu", "Aura Mew". The
release in --language is preferred. Without it the card sends a stored WISHMKR Jirachi.
zh_Hans: 配合 --gift event-pokemon：第三代配信的一份全新副本，由 PKHeX 按该活动自身的 PID/个体值方法生成，例如 “WISHMKR Jirachi”、“10 ANIV Pikachu”、“Aura Mew”。优先使用 --language 指定的版本。不指定时，卡片会发送一份内置的 WISHMKR Jirachi。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en:
with --gift rng-mon-hunt: how many states the stub may try before giving up and leaving the
rng alone. The default is the smallest cap that finds one 99 times in 100.
zh_Hans: 配合 --gift rng-mon-hunt：桩代码在放弃并保持 rng 不变之前最多尝试多少个状态。默认为能在 100 次中成功找到 99 次的最小上限。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en:
with --gift rng-mon-hunt: what the stub's own `setwildbattle` puts on the screen. Neither the
species nor the level is drawn from the rng, so this changes nothing about the
search. The default is a level 5 MAGIKARP, which is catchable in one ball.
zh_Hans: 配合 --gift rng-mon-hunt：桩代码自身的 `setwildbattle` 在屏幕上放出的内容。物种和等级都不来自 rng，因此这不影响搜索。默认是 5 级的 MAGIKARP，一个球即可捕获。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --gift rng-mon-hunt: the level that species appears at.
zh_Hans: 配合 --gift rng-mon-hunt：该物种出现的等级。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en:
which map group the RAM script binds to (a group_order index in
[decomp:data/maps/map_groups.json]). The default is the player's house, where the
mother never moves. Cerulean Cave B1F is group 1 map 74, and MEWTWO is object 3.
zh_Hans:
RAM 脚本绑定到哪个地图组（[decomp:data/maps/map_groups.json] 中的 group_order 索引）。默认是玩家的家，那里的
妈妈从不移动。华蓝洞窟 B1F 是组 1 地图 74，MEWTWO 是对象 3。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: which map in that group the RAM script binds to.
zh_Hans: RAM 脚本绑定到该组中的哪张地图。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en:
which object event on that map. Local ids are assigned in map.json order and start
at 1. Binding REPLACES that object's own script, so choose one that never moves.
zh_Hans:
该地图上的哪个对象事件。局部 id 按 map.json 中的顺序分配，并从
1 开始。绑定会替换该对象自身的脚本，因此请选一个从不移动的对象。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en:
with --gift rng-mon-hunt: how long the search may block the overworld in the worst case,
in frames (default 900, about 15 s). The field engine has not returned while it
searches, so the player sees a still frame with the music playing; criteria whose
search could take longer than this are refused before the card is built.
zh_Hans: 配合 --gift rng-mon-hunt：最坏情况下搜索最多可以阻塞原野多久，以帧计（默认 900，约 15 秒）。搜索期间原野引擎尚未返回，因此玩家看到的是音乐照常播放的静止画面；搜索可能超过此时长的条件会在构造卡片之前被拒绝。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: override the news id (1..65535). A console keeps news only when it differs from what it already holds [IsWonderNewsSameAsSaved], so bump this to re-send the same text to the same console
zh_Hans: 覆盖新闻 id（1..65535）。实机只在新闻与它已持有的不同时才保留它 [IsWonderNewsSameAsSaved]，所以要把同一段文本重发给同一台实机，就调大这个值
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: diagnostic: quiet child polls after LinkPlayer standby before the first Mystery Gift message; default is the built-in timing
zh_Hans: 诊断：LinkPlayer 待机之后、第一条神秘礼物消息之前的静默子轮询数；默认使用内置时序
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: diagnostic: idle VBlanks between the blocks of one Mystery Gift message; raise it if a run stalls part-way through a message (default is the built-in timing)
zh_Hans: 诊断：一条神秘礼物消息各块之间的空闲 VBlank 数；如果运行在消息中途卡住就把它调大（默认使用内置时序）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: emit each block fragment N times (1-8, default 2); bounded redundancy against the console's silent datagram drops
zh_Hans: 把每个块分片发送 N 次（1-8，默认 2）；以有限冗余对抗控制台的静默数据报丢失
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: fragment redundancy for the ident-25 delivery script alone (1-8, default 3); the console never reflects gift blocks, so a lost fragment cannot be resent
zh_Hans: 仅用于 ident-25 投递脚本的分片冗余（1-8，默认 3）；控制台从不回射礼物块，所以丢失的分片无法重发
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: stop after the post-delivery RFU close sequence; used by the supervised run_mystery_gift.sh host
zh_Hans: 在投递后的 RFU 关闭序列之后停止；由受监管的 run_mystery_gift.sh 房主使用
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: stop after this many seconds without meaningful Switch traffic (join or Pia/RFU datagram); default: disabled
zh_Hans: 在没有有意义的 Switch 流量（加入或 Pia/RFU 数据报）达到这么多秒后停止；默认：禁用
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: append completed joined-attempt records to daily csv files in DIR; default: disabled (the supervised shell host enables logs/)
zh_Hans: 把完成的加入尝试记录追加到 DIR 中按日生成的 csv 文件；默认：禁用（受监管的 shell 主机会启用 logs/）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: append what the console says about itself - its card counters, its four questionnaire words and its Easy Chat battle profile - to this jsonl ledger. tools/frlg/game_data_read.py reads it back and says what moved between sessions
zh_Hans: 把控制台关于自身的陈述 —— 它的卡片计数器、它的四个问卷词以及它的 Easy Chat 战斗资料 —— 追加到这个 jsonl 账本。tools/frlg/game_data_read.py 会读回它，并说明会话之间有哪些变化
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: write an annotated listing for the exact Mystery Gift bytes that will be sent (default: disabled)
zh_Hans: 为将要发送的确切神秘礼物字节写入带注释的清单（默认：禁用）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: directory for --make-artifact output (default: artifacts)
zh_Hans: --make-artifact 输出的目录（默认：artifacts）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: shared host TOML (default: config/host.toml)
zh_Hans: 共享房主 TOML（默认：config/host.toml）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: optional machine-local TOML (default: sibling host.local.toml)
zh_Hans: 可选的机器本地 TOML（默认：同目录的 host.local.toml）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: do not load host.local.toml
zh_Hans: 不加载 host.local.toml
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: print the safe effective host configuration and exit
zh_Hans: 打印安全且实际生效的主机配置并退出
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: trainer name; defaults to DEFAULT_TRAINER
zh_TW: 訓練家名稱；預設使用 DEFAULT_TRAINER
seed: 训练家名称；默认使用 DEFAULT_TRAINER
zh_Hans: 训练家名称；默认为 DEFAULT_TRAINER

en: game version; defaults to DEFAULT_TRAINER
zh_TW: 遊戲版本；預設使用 DEFAULT_TRAINER
seed: 游戏版本；默认使用 DEFAULT_TRAINER
zh_Hans: 游戏版本；默认为 DEFAULT_TRAINER

en: trainer language; defaults to DEFAULT_TRAINER
zh_TW: 訓練家語言；預設使用 DEFAULT_TRAINER
seed: 训练家语言；默认使用 DEFAULT_TRAINER
zh_Hans: 训练家语言；默认为 DEFAULT_TRAINER

en: decimal trainer ID, optionally followed by decimal secret ID
zh_TW: 十進位訓練家 ID，後方可選填十進位裏 ID
seed: 十进位训练家 ID，后方可选填十进位里 ID
zh_Hans: 十进制训练家 ID，后面可选填十进制里 ID

en: the Wonder Card flag id our trainer card claims in the Union Room card exchange. A console holding the card with that id arms its own card counters, so a trade or cable-club battle with us increments them [union_room.c:1777]; default 0, which arms nothing
zh_Hans: 我们在联盟交谊厅卡片交换中，训练家卡所声明的神秘卡片标志 id。持有该 id 卡片的主机会启用自身的卡片计数器，因此与我们进行交换或线缆俱乐部对战会使其递增 [union_room.c:1777]；默认 0，不启用任何计数器
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: use Pia-backed send-once block delivery (recommended); --no-trust-pia enables diagnostic RFU retransmits
zh_Hans: 使用由 Pia 支持的发送一次块投递（推荐）；--no-trust-pia 会启用诊断用的 RFU 重传
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: show detailed protocol logging instead of milestones
zh_Hans: 显示详细的协议日志，而不是里程碑
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: host for a real Switch
zh_Hans: 为真实的 Switch 当主机
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: LDN passphrase hex; default uses the frlg emulator value
zh_TW: 十六進位 LDN 通關密語；預設使用 frlg 模擬器的值
seed: 十六进位 LDN 通关密语；默认使用 frlg 模拟器的值
zh_Hans: 十六进制 LDN 口令；默认使用 frlg 模拟器的值

en: Wi-Fi phy; explicit phyN overrides --adapter
zh_TW: Wi-Fi phy；明確指定 phyN 時會優先於 --adapter
seed: Wi-Fi phy；明确指定 phyN 时会优先于 --adapter
zh_Hans: Wi-Fi phy；显式指定 phyN 时会覆盖 --adapter

en: named Wi-Fi adapter profile used while --phy is auto
zh_TW: --phy 設為 auto 時使用的具名 Wi-Fi 網卡設定檔
seed: --phy 设为 auto 时使用的具名 Wi-Fi 网卡设置档
zh_Hans: --phy 为 auto 时使用的具名 Wi-Fi 网卡配置文件

en: host for an emulated console over the LAN instead of over the radio: answer ldn_mitm discovery on port 11452 and carry Pia over UDP. Takes the address to advertise, or auto. Needs no adapter, no prod.keys and no root
zh_Hans: 通过局域网而不是无线，为模拟控制台当主机：在端口 11452 上应答 ldn_mitm 发现，并用 UDP 承载 Pia。取要通告的地址，或 auto。不需要适配器，不需要 prod.keys，也不需要 root
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: LDN local_communication_id in hexadecimal
zh_Hans: 十六进制的 LDN local_communication_id
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: record an optional JSONL protocol diagnostic
zh_TW: 選擇性記錄 JSONL 格式的通訊協定診斷資料
seed: 选择性记录 JSONL 格式的通信协定诊断数据
zh_Hans: 记录一份可选的 JSONL 协议诊断数据

en: LDN scene; default is the known FRLG scene
zh_Hans: LDN 场景；默认为已知的 FRLG 场景
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: delegate transmit CCMP to mac80211/hardware; over-air frames remain encrypted
zh_Hans: 把发送 CCMP 交给 mac80211/硬件处理；空中帧仍保持加密
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: accept hardware-decrypted RX frames that retain their CCMP header and mic (TP-Link Archer T3U/rtw88_8822bu profile)
zh_Hans: 接受保留了 CCMP 头和 MIC 的硬件解密接收帧（TP-Link Archer T3U/rtw88_8822bu 配置）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: use FireRed's session-wide incrementing Pia nonce
zh_Hans: 使用火红版会话级递增的 Pia nonce
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send Session type 2 unicast before type 5 broadcast
zh_Hans: 在 type 5 广播之前先单播 Session type 2
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how many RFU slots a second the host emits (default 59.727, one per GBA VBlank). A real console pair runs far below this; lowering it slows every link step by the same factor.
zh_Hans: 主机每秒发出多少个 RFU 槽位（默认 59.727，每个 GBA VBlank 一个）。真实的一对实机远低于此；调低它会让每个连接步骤按相同倍数变慢。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: received-mon output path
zh_TW: 收到的寶可夢檔案的輸出路徑
seed: 收到的宝可梦文件的输出路径
zh_Hans: 收到的宝可梦的输出路径

en: write every Pokemon the console shows on the trade screen to this folder, whether or not the trade goes through
zh_TW: 將主機交換畫面上顯示的每隻寶可夢寫入此資料夾，不論交換是否完成。
seed: 将主机交换画面上显示的每只宝可梦写入此文件夹，不论交换是否完成。
zh_Hans: 将主机在交换界面上显示的每只宝可梦写入此文件夹，无论交换是否成功

en: 0-based host party slot offered for one trade (default: 1)
zh_Hans: 一次交换中提供的主机端同行位置，从 0 开始计数（默认：1）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: comma-separated 0-based offered slots for multiple trades
zh_Hans: 用于多次交换的、从 0 开始的逗号分隔提议槽位
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: host for the Union Room (the middle NPC on Pokemon Center 2F) instead of the trade centre's third NPC; use with --union-room-keepalive 120 and --board-type
zh_Hans: 为联盟室（宝可梦中心 2F 中间的 NPC）当主机，而不是交换中心的第三个 NPC；配合 --union-room-keepalive 120 和 --board-type 使用
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: host the cable-club COLOSSEUM instead of the trade centre (Pokemon Center 2F, third NPC -> Colosseum -> Single Battle -> JOIN). The entry is the trade centre's, so --card-flag-id still arms the console's card counters, and only this path increments its battlesWon [decomp:src/cable_club.c:792]. The whole party fights
zh_Hans: 开设电缆俱乐部 COLOSSEUM，而不是交换中心（宝可梦中心 2F，第三个 NPC -> Colosseum -> Single Battle -> JOIN）。入口仍是交换中心的，所以 --card-flag-id 仍会启动控制台的卡片计数器，而只有这条路径会增加其 battlesWon [decomp:src/cable_club.c:792]。整支队伍都会参战
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: which activity --union-room advertises; default 'in-room', the bare IN_UNION_ROOM a console standing in the room connects to. 'search' is what the screen before the room looks for (untested)
zh_Hans: --union-room 广播哪种活动；默认为 “in-room”，即站在房间里的主机所连接的那个裸 IN_UNION_ROOM。“search” 是房间之前那个界面所寻找的值（未测试）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: Union Room: re-present a parent NI_START for N VBlanks before the first UNI frame; the room child drops the link after five unanswered frames, and enters UNI 480 frames after the last NI_START. 120 is proven
zh_Hans: 联盟交谊厅：在第一个 UNI 帧之前，用 N 个 VBlank 重新发送父级 NI_START；若连续五帧无人应答，房间子进程就会断开链路，而它在最后一个 NI_START 之后 480 帧才进入 UNI。120 已验证
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: Union Room trading board: register the offered Pokemon (its species and level) and ask for this type in return, so the console's board lists us. The console must have a Pokemon of that type to start the trade
zh_Hans: 联盟交谊厅交换板：登记所提供的宝可梦（其种类和等级）并求换该属性的宝可梦，这样主机的交换板上就会列出我们。主机必须拥有该属性的宝可梦才能开始交换
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: override the level shown on the trading board
zh_Hans: 覆盖交换板上显示的等级
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: Union Room: accept the console's 'Tchat' instead of declining it. Both sides send a join block, then the console's keyboard opens and every line it types is logged
zh_Hans: 联盟交谊厅：接受主机的“Tchat”而不是拒绝。双方各发送一个加入块，随后主机的键盘会打开，它输入的每一行都会被记录下来
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: Union Room: accept the console's Combat instead of declining it. The console needs two non-egg party mons at level 30 or lower or it refuses on its own screen; it is master and runs the battle, we answer its controller commands
zh_Hans: 联盟交谊厅：接受主机的“Combat”而不是拒绝。主机的同行中需要有两只 30 级或以下的非蛋宝可梦，否则它会在自己的屏幕上拒绝；对战由主机主控并运行，我们负责应答它的控制器命令
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: Union Room battle: pick fight with the first move instead of forfeiting at the first action prompt. Only the forfeit path has been proven on hardware

en: run native ARM code on the console through CLI_RUN_BUFFER_SCRIPT instead of sending a gift: trainer-id-probe: read playerTrainerId out of gSaveBlock2Ptr and return it (reads only, writes nothing); save-dump: read out any part of either save block, using the pointers the console hands us - no absolute address needed (reads only, writes nothing); memory-dump: read out any region of the console's memory by repointing the console's own outgoing message at it (needs --dump-address; reads only, writes nothing); memory-dump-multi: the same, but SEVERAL consecutive blocks in one session (--dump-address --dump-blocks N): the client script runs the payload once per block and each pass sends the next kilobyte; memory-dump-scatter: the same, but the blocks are UNRELATED addresses (--dump-scatter A,B,C): the payload carries a table of bases and the cursor indexes it, so one session reads the sixteen kilobytes a plan actually asked for rather than sixteen consecutive ones; save-write: write bytes into a save block and read the same region back in the same run; the console saves afterwards, so the write reaches flash (--write-hex, --dump-block, --dump-offset); rng-trace: sample one word of memory once a frame, optionally calling a ROM function between the two halves of each sample, and check the LCG recurrence on what comes back (--trace-address, --trace-call, --trace-samples; reads only, plus whatever the callee does); memory-scan: search memory for a 32-bit value and send back where it is; it returns 0 to be called again next frame, so one run covers a range no dump could (--scan-word, --scan-start, --scan-end, --scan-blocks; reads only, writes nothing); table-scan: search memory for a table by its shape, a run of N words each exactly D above the one before it, and send back where each run starts and what value it starts with; this is how a table of pointers is found when no constant in it is known (--table-delta, --table-runlen, --table-start, --table-end, --table-blocks; reads only, writes nothing); rom-checksum: checksum a range of memory in up to 128 blocks and send back one sum per block; the host sets them beside the same sums over a ROM image and names the blocks that differ (--sum-start, --sum-end, --sum-block, --sum-budget, --sum-reference; reads only, writes nothing); anchors: ask the machine where it is: our own load address, the return address into ROM, the stack and the client's five buffers (writes only its own outgoing buffer); create-mon: call CreateMon, a ROM function taking eight arguments, and send back the 100-byte struct Pokemon it built; the mon is built inside our own image, so nothing on the console is written unless --create-mon-append or --create-mon-destination asks for it (--create-mon-call, --create-mon-species, --create-mon-level, --create-mon-personality); string-gather: follow an array of pointers and send back the strings themselves, back to back, instead of a window of mostly-pointers: a whole Easy Chat group in one run (--gather-address, --gather-count, --gather-stride; reads only, writes nothing); call: call any ROM function with arguments we choose, up to eight words in r0..r3 then the stack, and send back its r0 with one address read either side of the call (--call-address, --call-arg, --call-watch); the payload writes nothing itself, but the callee may, so the address has to have been read as code first; flash-read: select the flash bank, byte-copy a save sector out of the 64 KiB window into EWRAM with the CPU, and send the COPY: the console's outgoing message cannot be pointed at flash itself (--flash-sector, --flash-read-offset, --dump-size; reads only, writes nothing); flash-patch: read a save sector out of flash through the banked window, change one field, recompute the checksum and write it back with swi 0x48, then bump the counter-bearing sector so the loader adopts the band. Nothing is rebuilt from RAM, so a field the save routine serializes cannot be lost (--flash-id, --flash-patch-offset, --flash-patch-hex; needs --write-unsafe); flash-write: compose 4 KB in EWRAM on the console and write it straight into a flash sector with swi 0x48, instead of going through the game's save code entirely - no counter, checksum or signature (--flash-sector, --flash-fill-base, --flash-fill-step, --flash-words; a sector inside the save bands needs --write-unsafe); call-chain: run a LIST of ROM calls and memory accesses in one frame and send back a word for each, any step able to use the previous step's result as its address - which is how a function that returns a pointer (GetVarPointer) becomes a write (--chain-step, repeatable; a write step needs --write-unsafe); sloop-svc: issue one Sloop syscall (swi 0x40..0x62) with r0..r3 we choose, optionally pointing r0 or r1 at up to 256 bytes we send, and send back the registers and the bytes as the syscall left them (--svc-number, --svc-arg, --svc-text/--svc-hex, --svc-data-in; a number outside the read-only set needs --write-unsafe); install-resident: copy a resident hook into the top of EWRAM and install it in gIntrTable[4], where it runs every frame until a soft reset; answers with the V-blank handler it found (--resident turbo, --resident-param extra=N field=N battle=N hold=0x100 budget=228; needs --write-unsafe); install-kept: install the resident hook kept in the save's filler_B20 (written by save-write --resident), after checking its sum; answers with the V-blank handler it found, 0xBAD0BAD0 when nothing was installed; rom-reset-probe: write a 4 KB pattern into the ROM copy at 0x08000000 + n * 0x1000 through the swi 0x48 fold, then GBA-soft-reset, to settle whether a ROM-copy write survives a soft reset. A second Mystery Gift session dumps the address (--rom-fold-n, --rom-fill-base; needs --write-unsafe)
zh_Hans: 通过 CLI_RUN_BUFFER_SCRIPT 在主机上运行原生 ARM 代码，而不是发送礼物：trainer-id-probe：从 gSaveBlock2Ptr 读出 playerTrainerId 并返回（只读，不写入任何内容）；save-dump：利用主机交给我们的指针读出两个存档块中任意一块的任意部分，无需绝对地址（只读，不写入任何内容）；memory-dump：把主机自己的外发消息重新指向目标，从而读出主机内存的任意区域（需要 --dump-address；只读，不写入任何内容）；memory-dump-multi：同上，但在一次会话中读取若干个连续块（--dump-address --dump-blocks N）：客户端脚本对每个块运行一次载荷，每一轮发送下一个千字节；memory-dump-scatter：同上，但各块是互不相关的地址（--dump-scatter A,B,C）：载荷携带一张基址表，由游标索引它，因此一次会话读的是计划真正要求的十六千字节，而不是十六个连续千字节；save-write：向存档块写入字节，并在同一次运行中读回同一区域；主机随后会存档，因此写入会落到 flash（--write-hex、--dump-block、--dump-offset）；rng-trace：每帧采样一个内存字，可在每次采样的两半之间调用一个 ROM 函数，并对返回的东西检查 LCG 递推（--trace-address、--trace-call、--trace-samples；只读，外加被调用函数自身所做的一切）；memory-scan：在内存中搜索一个 32 位值并返回它所在的位置；它返回 0 表示下一帧再被调用，因此一次运行可覆盖任何 dump 都无法覆盖的范围（--scan-word、--scan-start、--scan-end、--scan-blocks；只读，不写入任何内容）；table-scan：按形状在内存中搜索一张表，即 N 个连续的字、每个都恰好比前一个高 D，并返回每一段的起始位置及其起始值；当表中没有任何已知常量时，就是这样找到指针表的（--table-delta、--table-runlen、--table-start、--table-end、--table-blocks；只读，不写入任何内容）；rom-checksum：对一段内存做校验和，最多分 128 块，每块返回一个和；主机把它们与同一 ROM 镜像上的相同和并列比较，并指出不同的块（--sum-start、--sum-end、--sum-block、--sum-budget、--sum-reference；只读，不写入任何内容）；anchors：向机器询问它在哪里：我们自己的加载地址、返回 ROM 的返回地址、栈，以及客户端的五个缓冲区（只写它自己的外发缓冲区）；create-mon：调用 CreateMon，一个接收八个参数的 ROM 函数，并返回它构建的 100 字节 struct Pokemon；宝可梦构建在我们自己的镜像内，因此除非 --create-mon-append 或 --create-mon-destination 要求，主机上不会被写入任何内容（--create-mon-call、--create-mon-species、--create-mon-level、--create-mon-personality）；string-gather：跟随一个指针数组并把字符串本身连续发回，而不是发回一个大多是指针的窗口：一次运行取回整个 Easy Chat 组（--gather-address、--gather-count、--gather-stride；只读，不写入任何内容）；call：以我们选定的参数调用任意 ROM 函数，最多八个字，先放 r0..r3 再放栈，并返回其 r0，同时在调用两侧各读一个地址（--call-address、--call-arg、--call-watch）；载荷本身不写入任何内容，但被调用函数可能会写，因此该地址必须已先作为代码读过；flash-read：选择 flash bank，用 CPU 从 64 KiB 窗口中按字节复制一个存档扇区到 EWRAM，并发送这份副本：主机的外发消息无法直接指向 flash 本身（--flash-sector、--flash-read-offset、--dump-size；只读，不写入任何内容）；flash-patch：通过分 bank 的窗口从 flash 读出一个存档扇区，修改一个字段，重算校验和并用 swi 0x48 写回，然后递增带计数器的扇区，好让加载器采用该 band。不从 RAM 重建任何东西，因此存档例程会序列化的字段不会丢失（--flash-id、--flash-patch-offset、--flash-patch-hex；需要 --write-unsafe）；flash-write：在主机上的 EWRAM 中拼出 4 KB，并用 swi 0x48 直接写入一个 flash 扇区，完全绕开游戏的存档代码 - 没有计数器、校验和或签名（--flash-sector、--flash-fill-base、--flash-fill-step、--flash-words；位于存档 band 内的扇区需要 --write-unsafe）；call-chain：在一帧内运行一组 ROM 调用和内存访问，并为每一步返回一个字，任何一步都可以把上一步的结果用作自己的地址 - 这正是让返回指针的函数（GetVarPointer）变成一次写入的方式（--chain-step，可重复；写入步骤需要 --write-unsafe）；sloop-svc：以我们选定的 r0..r3 发出一个 Sloop 系统调用（swi 0x40..0x62），可选地把 r0 或 r1 指向我们发送的最多 256 字节，并按系统调用留下的状态返回寄存器和这些字节（--svc-number、--svc-arg、--svc-text/--svc-hex、--svc-data-in；只读集合之外的编号需要 --write-unsafe）；install-resident：把一个常驻钩子复制到 EWRAM 顶部并安装到 gIntrTable[4]，它会在那里每帧运行，直到软复位；返回它找到的 V-blank 处理程序（--resident turbo，--resident-param extra=N field=N battle=N hold=0x100 budget=228；需要 --write-unsafe）；install-kept：在检查校验和后，安装保存在存档 filler_B20 中的常驻钩子（由 save-write --resident 写入）；返回它找到的 V-blank 处理程序，未安装任何东西时返回 0xBAD0BAD0；rom-reset-probe：通过 swi 0x48 折叠把 4 KB 模式写入 0x08000000 + n * 0x1000 处的 ROM 副本，然后做 GBA 软复位，以确定 ROM 副本的写入能否经受软复位。第二次神秘礼物会话会 dump 该地址（--rom-fold-n、--rom-fill-base；需要 --write-unsafe）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

zh_Hans: 除非加入的实机是这张卡带，否则拒绝该会话，并对照其游戏数据中的版本进行检查。不匹配时不发送任何内容
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: whose addresses a hook, a stub or a ROM call is built with: BPRF, BPGF, BPRE, BPGE, BPRS, BPGS, BPRD, BPGD, BPRI, BPGI, BPRJ, BPGJ. auto (the default) builds for each and sends the one the console's game code names, before anything address-dependent is sent; another code is refused. A game code serves only that cartridge. Bytes with no build address go to any console either way
zh_Hans: hook、stub 或 ROM 调用按哪个游戏代号构建地址：BPRF、BPGF、BPRE、BPGE、BPRS、BPGS、BPRD、BPGD、BPRI、BPGI、BPRJ、BPGJ。auto（默认）会为每个代号构建，并在发送任何依赖地址的内容之前，发送主机游戏代码所指明的那个；其他代号会被拒绝。一个游戏代码只服务于对应卡带。没有构建地址的字节无论如何都会发往任何主机
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script call-chain: one step, repeatable, up to 16, run in order in one frame. `call:NAME_OR_ADDR[,ARG]...` calls a ROM function (AddBagItem, AddMoney, AddPCItem, CalcCRC16, CheckBagHasItem, CheckBagHasSpace, CompactPartySlots, CreateMon, FlagClear, FlagGet, FlagSet, GetMoney, GetSetPokedexFlag, GetVarPointer, IncrementGameStat, InitRamScript, IsEnoughMoney, ItemIsMail, Random, ReadFlash, RemoveBagItem, RemoveMoney, RunScriptImmediately, SeedRng, SpeciesToNationalPokedexNum, StringCompare, VarGet, VarSet, or a THUMB address); `read32|read16|read8:ADDR` reads; `write32|write16|write8:ADDR,VALUE` writes and reads itself back, and needs --write-unsafe. A target of `prev` is the PREVIOUS step's result and `prev+N` is N bytes past it, which is how a function that returns a pointer becomes a write; an op may carry +keep to leave prev alone. Example: --chain-step call:GetVarPointer,0x4024 --chain-step write16:prev,7. A named function is resolved on the console's build
zh_Hans: --buffer-script call-chain：一个步骤，可重复，最多 16 个，在一帧内按顺序执行。`call:NAME_OR_ADDR[,ARG]...` 调用 ROM 函数（AddBagItem、AddMoney、AddPCItem、CalcCRC16、CheckBagHasItem、CheckBagHasSpace、CompactPartySlots、CreateMon、FlagClear、FlagGet、FlagSet、GetMoney、GetSetPokedexFlag、GetVarPointer、IncrementGameStat、InitRamScript、IsEnoughMoney、ItemIsMail、Random、ReadFlash、RemoveBagItem、RemoveMoney、RunScriptImmediately、SeedRng、SpeciesToNationalPokedexNum、StringCompare、VarGet、VarSet，或一个 THUMB 地址）；`read32|read16|read8:ADDR` 读取；`write32|write16|write8:ADDR,VALUE` 写入并回读自身，且需要 --write-unsafe。目标为 `prev` 表示上一步的结果，`prev+N` 表示其后 N 字节，这正是把返回指针的函数变成写入的方式；一个操作可带 +keep 以保持 prev 不变。示例：--chain-step call:GetVarPointer,0x4024 --chain-step write16:prev,7。具名函数会在主机的构建版本上解析
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: the ROM function to call with eight arguments, a THUMB pointer. The default is the console build's CreateMon (0x08041151 French, 0x080411FD English); 0 calls nothing, which checks the send path with the ROM left out
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：以八个参数调用的 ROM 函数，THUMB 指针。默认是主机版本的 CreateMon（法文版 0x08041151，英文版 0x080411FD）；0 表示不调用任何函数，用于在不涉及 ROM 的情况下检查发送路径
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: the species number, 1..411 (internal numbering, not the National Dex)
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：宝可梦编号，1..411（内部编号，不是全国图鉴编号）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: the level, 1..100
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：等级，1..100
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: every IV set to this, 0..31. 32 or more rolls them instead [USE_RANDOM_IVS], which makes the run non-deterministic
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：所有个体值都设为这个值，0..31。32 或更大则改为随机生成 [USE_RANDOM_IVS]，这会使运行结果不确定
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: the 32-bit personality value, which fixes the nature, the gender, the ability slot and, with the trainer ids, whether the mon is shiny. Omitted, the console rolls one with Random32
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：32 位性格值，它决定性格、性别、特性槽，并与训练家 ID 一起决定宝可梦是否异色。省略时，主机用 Random32 随机生成一个
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: 0 = the OT is the player and the id comes off the real save, 1 = use --create-mon-ot-id, 2 = rolled until not shiny
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：0 = 初训家是玩家，ID 取自真实存档；1 = 使用 --create-mon-ot-id；2 = 反复随机直到不是异色
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon --create-mon-ot-id-type 1: the OT id to use
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon --create-mon-ot-id-type 1：要使用的初训家 ID
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: append the finished mon to the player's party. The slot is computed from gSaveBlock1Ptr, never given, and it is always the first free one - playerParty[playerPartyCount] - so an occupied slot is never touched and no Pokemon can be destroyed. A full party writes nothing and says so. This is the player's live SAVE and the console commits it to flash: needs --write-unsafe
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：把生成的宝可梦追加到玩家的队伍。槽位由 gSaveBlock1Ptr 计算得出，不能直接指定，且始终是第一个空闲槽 - playerParty[playerPartyCount] - 因此绝不会碰到已占用的槽位，也不会有宝可梦被销毁。队伍已满时不写入任何内容并会说明。这是玩家的实时存档，主机会把它提交到 flash：需要 --write-unsafe
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: the same run as --create-mon-append - the same call, the same arithmetic on the same gSaveBlock1Ptr - with the two stores that would change the save left out. It reports the party count and the address it would have written, and reads that slot's current 100 bytes back so the answer says what a real run would overwrite. Writes nothing, so it needs no override
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：与 --create-mon-append 相同的运行 - 相同的调用、对同一个 gSaveBlock1Ptr 的相同运算 - 只是省略了会修改存档的两处写入。它会报告队伍数量和本应写入的地址，并读回该槽位当前的 100 字节，因此结果能说明真实运行会覆盖什么。不写入任何内容，所以不需要额外授权
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script create-mon: copy the finished 100 bytes to this address in the console's memory. The mon is built in our own image either way, so without this nothing on the console is written at all. Needs --write-unsafe
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script create-mon：把生成的 100 字节复制到主机内存中的这个地址。无论哪种方式，宝可梦都在我们自己的映像里构建，因此不指定它就不会向主机写入任何内容。需要 --write-unsafe
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script save-write: ascii to write into the save block at --dump-offset. The same region is read back in the same run, so the answer is the proof. The console saves afterwards, so it reaches flash
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script save-write：写入 --dump-offset 处存档块的 ASCII 内容。同一次运行中会读回同一区域，因此结果即是证明。主机会随后保存，所以内容会进入 flash
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script save-write: the bytes to write, as hex
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script save-write：要写入的字节，以十六进制给出
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script flash-write: the 4 KB flash sector (0..31) swi 0x48 writes. Sectors 0..27 are the two save bands and need --write-unsafe; 28..31 are outside both
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-write：swi 0x48 要写入的 4 KB flash 扇区（0..31）。扇区 0..27 属于两个存档区段，需要 --write-unsafe；28..31 不属于其中任何一个
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script rom-reset-probe: the 4 KB block in the ROM copy to write, 0..0xFFF; the address is 0x08000000 + N * 0x1000. The payload writes a pattern there and soft-resets; needs --write-unsafe
zh_TW: 搭配 --buffer-script rom-reset-probe：指定要寫入的 ROM 副本區塊，每塊 4 KB，範圍為 0..0xFFF；位址為 0x08000000 + N * 0x1000。執行後會寫入測試樣式並進行軟重置；須加上 --write-unsafe
seed: 搭配 --buffer-script rom-reset-probe：指定要写入的 ROM 副本区块，每块 4 KB，范围为 0..0xFFF；地址为 0x08000000 + N * 0x1000。运行后会写入测试样式并进行软重置；须加上 --write-unsafe
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script rom-reset-probe：要写入的 ROM 副本区块（每块 4 KB），范围为 0..0xFFF；地址为 0x08000000 + N * 0x1000。载荷会在该处写入一段模式并进行软重启；需要 --write-unsafe

en: with --buffer-script rom-reset-probe: word[0] of the pattern (default 'EMER')
zh_TW: 搭配 --buffer-script rom-reset-probe：測試樣式的 word[0]（預設為 'EMER'）
seed: 搭配 --buffer-script rom-reset-probe：测试样式的 word[0]（默认为 'EMER'）
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script rom-reset-probe：模式的 word[0]（默认为 'EMER'）

en: with --buffer-script flash-write: word[0] of the pattern the console composes
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-write：主机所构造模式的 word[0]
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script flash-write: added to each word of the pattern
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-write：加到模式的每个字上
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script flash-write: how many words of the sector to compose
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-write：要构造扇区的多少个字
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script flash-write: compose a WELL-FORMED save sector instead of a raw pattern - the console zeroes past the data, computes the game's own checksum over the 3968-byte data area and lays down id, checksum, signature and counter
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-write：构造一个格式正确的存档扇区，而不是原始模式 - 主机将数据之后的部分清零，对 3968 字节的数据区计算游戏自身的校验和，并写入 id、校验和、签名和计数器
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --flash-footer: the sector id written at +0xFF4
zh_Hans: 配合 --flash-footer：写入 +0xFF4 的扇区 ID
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --flash-footer: the save counter written at +0xFFC
zh_Hans: 配合 --flash-footer：写入 +0xFFC 的存档计数器
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --flash-footer: read gLastWrittenSector and gSaveCounter on the console and write the sector the --flash-id actually occupies right now, rather than a position computed when the payload was built. Needs --write-unsafe
zh_Hans: 配合 --flash-footer：在主机上读取 gLastWrittenSector 和 gSaveCounter，写入 --flash-id 此刻实际所在的扇区，而不是构造 payload 时计算出的位置。需要 --write-unsafe
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script sloop-svc: a syscall, 0x40..0x62 (0x4D is the bad-word check); repeat for up to eight, issued in order in one session
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script sloop-svc：一个系统调用，0x40..0x62（0x4D 是 bad-word 检查）；最多重复八次，在一次会话中按顺序发出
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script sloop-svc: r0, r1, r2, r3 in order (repeatable)
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script sloop-svc：依次为 r0、r1、r2、r3（可重复）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script sloop-svc: up to 256 bytes of UTF-8 data to send
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script sloop-svc：要发送的 UTF-8 数据，最多 256 字节
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script sloop-svc: the data as hex instead

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script install-resident：要安装的挂钩（turbo）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script install-resident：一个挂钩参数，例如 extra=6

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script sloop-svc：改为发出 THUMB 的 `bkpt N` 而不是 `swi N`（0xFF 是游戏从不发出的那个；需要 --write-unsafe）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script sloop-svc: point this register at the console's copy of the data
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script sloop-svc：让这个寄存器指向主机上的数据副本
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script flash-read: byte offset into the sector to start reading at
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-read：从扇区内开始读取的字节偏移
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --buffer-script flash-patch: byte offset of the field inside the sector's data
zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-patch：该字段在扇区数据内的字节偏移

zh_Hans: 配合 --buffer-script flash-patch：该字段的替换字节，以十六进制给出。扇区中其余内容都保持游戏自身存档例程写入的样子

en: with --flash-derive: aim at band position N (0..13) and derive the ID from it, instead of deriving the position from --flash-id. Position 13 is the sector whose counter GetSaveValidStatus reports for the whole slot
zh_Hans: 配合 --flash-derive：瞄准区段位置 N（0..13）并由它推导出 ID，而不是从 --flash-id 推导位置。位置 13 是 GetSaveValidStatus 为整个槽位报告计数器的那一个扇区

en: with --flash-derive: added to gSaveCounter for the footer. 0 keeps the sector in its own band; a positive value is what would outrank the live slot
zh_Hans: 配合 --flash-derive：加到页脚所用的 gSaveCounter 上。0 让该扇区留在自己的区段内；正值则可压过活动槽位

en: allow a save write outside struct SaveBlock2's never-read filler regions. This is the player's live save and the console commits it to flash; without this the write is refused
zh_Hans: 允许写入 SaveBlock2 结构中从不读取的填充区域之外的存档内容。这是玩家的实时存档，主机会把它写入闪存；没有此选项时写入会被拒绝
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: Wonder Card flagId, 1000..1019; without this option, the selected gift's registered default shown below is used
zh_Hans: 神秘卡片 flagId，1000..1019；不使用此选项时，会采用所选礼物已注册的默认值，见下方

en:
require the console to be holding this four-word Easy Chat phrase in its Poke Mart
questionnaire before anything is sent [SVR_CHECK_QUESTIONNAIRE]. Each word is an
English word name, `species:N`, `move:N`, `group/index`, or a raw id. Word ids are
per-language outside the species and move groups, so read the phrase off the target
console first: every session logs the four ids it is holding.
zh_Hans: 要求主机在商店问卷中持有这条四词 Easy Chat 短语后才会发送任何内容 [SVR_CHECK_QUESTIONNAIRE]。每个词是一个英文单词名、`species:N`、`move:N`、`group/index` 或原始 id。在 species 与 move 组之外，词 id 按语言区分，所以先从目标主机上读出该短语：每次会话都会记录它当前持有的四个 id。

en: what a console that does not know the phrase reads (max 63 characters); the default is 'That is not the phrase.'
zh_Hans: 不认识该口令的主机所读到的内容（最多 63 个字符）；默认为 “That is not the phrase.”

en:
with --gift rng-mon-hunt: which natures the search will accept, comma separated
(Hardy, Lonely, Brave, Adamant, Naughty, Bold, ...), or plain ids. Without this it takes any.
zh_Hans: 配合 --gift rng-mon-hunt：搜索会接受哪些性格，以逗号分隔（Hardy、Lonely、Brave、Adamant、Naughty、Bold 等），也可用纯数字 ID。不指定则接受任意性格。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en:
with --gift rng-mon-hunt: a floor under one IV, repeatable (speed=31, attack=20). The stats
are hp, attack, defense, speed, sp_attack, sp_defense, named in the order the ROM draws them - which is not the order the summary
screen shows.
zh_Hans: 配合 --gift rng-mon-hunt：某一项个体值的下限，可重复（speed=31、attack=20）。各项依次为 hp、attack、defense、speed、sp_attack、sp_defense，按 ROM 抽取它们的顺序命名 - 并非摘要界面显示的顺序。

en:
with --gift event-pokemon: a fresh copy of a Gen 3 distribution, made by PKHeX by that event's
own PID/IV method, e.g. "WISHMKR Jirachi", "10 ANIV Pikachu", "Aura Mew". The

zh_Hans: 配合 --gift event-pokemon：第三代配信的一份全新副本，由 PKHeX 按该活动自身的 PID/个体值方法生成，例如 “WISHMKR Jirachi”、“10 ANIV Pikachu”、“Aura Mew”。优先使用 --language 指定的版本。不指定时，卡片会发送一份内置的 WISHMKR Jirachi。

with --gift rng-mon-hunt: how many states the stub may try before giving up and leaving the

zh_Hans: 配合 --gift rng-mon-hunt：桩代码在放弃并保持 rng 不变之前最多尝试多少个状态。默认为能在 100 次中成功找到 99 次的最小上限。

with --gift rng-mon-hunt: what the stub's own `setwildbattle` puts on the screen. Neither the

zh_Hans: 配合 --gift rng-mon-hunt：桩代码自身的 `setwildbattle` 在屏幕上放出的内容。物种和等级都不来自 rng，因此这不影响搜索。默认是 5 级的 MAGIKARP，一个球即可捕获。

en: with --gift rng-mon-hunt: the level that species appears at.

zh_TW: --lan：搜尋連線時指定的最大玩家人數；團體戰或極巨大冒險預設為 4，交換預設為 2

en: readings of the header byte at 0x05, in order; the IV's source id follows each one
zh_Hans: 0x05 处头字节的读数，按顺序；每个读数后面跟着 IV 的来源 id

en: per reading
