en: seconds without an update session that count as the rebroadcast stopping - the console sends ten a second, so this is fifteen missed
zh_Hans: 没有 update 会话达到多少秒就算重广播停止 - 主机每秒发送十条，所以这里是漏掉十五条
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: THE CONTROL. Ack a sequence id the console never sent: a rebroadcast that carries on under --seq-delta 1 is what attributes a stop under 0 to the ack's CONTENT rather than to our merely having transmitted
zh_Hans: 对照组。对主机从未发送过的序列号回 ACK：若在 --seq-delta 1 下重播照旧继续，就说明 0 下的停止归因于 ACK 的内容，而不是仅仅因为我们发送过 ACK
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after the ack, sweep the version-4 connection request on protocol 0x14
zh_Hans: 收到 ack 后，在协议 0x14 上扫描版本 4 的连接请求
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: values for byte [1], list or LO-HI
zh_Hans: 字节 [1] 的取值，列表或 LO-HI
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: values for byte [0x10]
zh_Hans: 字节 [0x10] 的取值
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: seconds between requests; the console answered BDSP's in 40 ms
zh_Hans: 请求之间的秒数；主机在 40 ms 内应答了 BDSP 的请求
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: values for the header byte at 0x05 on the requests, and their IV source id; list or LO-HI
zh_Hans: 请求中 0x05 处头部字节及其 IV 源 id 的取值；列表或 LO-HI
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer a connection request the CONSOLE sends us with a connection response
zh_Hans: 用连接响应应答控制台发给我们的连接请求
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: 0 is accepted
zh_Hans: 0 也可接受
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: whose constant and variable id go in the response's two id fields - a deduction, so 'both' alternates them across the retransmits
zh_Hans: 响应中两个 id 字段分别放入谁的常量 id 和变量 id——这是推断，因此 “both” 会在多次重传中交替使用两者
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: values for the platform byte at [2]. 9 is the real one; ANY other value is answered with a connection response rather than dropped, which is the probe for whether our message reaches the 0x14 handler at all
zh_Hans: [2] 处平台字节的取值。9 是真实值；任何其他值都会得到连接响应而不是被丢弃，这可用于探测我们的消息是否真的到达 0x14 处理程序
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: values for the MESSAGE flags byte. 0x09 is what the console puts on its own Local Protocol messages; BDSP's station requests carry 0x11
zh_Hans: MESSAGE 标志字节的取值。0x09 是主机在自己的 Local Protocol 消息上使用的值；BDSP 的站点请求携带 0x11
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send the requests to the console rather than the broadcast address
zh_Hans: 把请求发送给主机而不是广播地址
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send them to the broadcast address instead
zh_Hans: 改为把它们发送到广播地址
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: our own station variable id; fresh random when omitted, because a reused one is 'already one of my stations' on BDSP
zh_Hans: 我们自己的站点变量 id；省略时为新的随机值，因为在 BDSP 上复用一个会被当成“already one of my stations”
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: clear [3], which makes the console skip the variable-id comparison
zh_Hans: 清除 [3]，这会让控制台跳过变量 id 比较
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send to the console rather than the broadcast address
zh_Hans: 发送给主机而不是广播地址
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after the station handshake closes, send the Mesh Protocol (0x18) join request and ack whatever comes back
zh_Hans: 站点握手关闭后，发送 Mesh Protocol（0x18）加入请求，并对返回的任何内容回 ack
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how long to wait for the station acceptance before giving up on joining
zh_Hans: 等待站点接受多久后放弃加入
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how long to retransmit the join request; Pia's own joiner gives up at 10
zh_Hans: 重传加入请求多久；Pia 自带的加入端到 10 就放弃
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: Pia retransmits an unacknowledged join request every 500 ms
zh_Hans: Pia 每 500 毫秒重传一次未确认的加入请求
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the Pia port the join travels on; the update mesh uses the reliable one
zh_Hans: 加入流程所使用的 Pia 端口；更新网格使用可靠端口
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: byte [1]. 0xFD is what 0x017c1700 compares against; anything else is the instrument that says the handler was reached
zh_Hans: 字节 [1]。0xFD 是 0x017c1700 比较所针对的值；其他任何值都是说明已进入处理程序的标志
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: fixed ack id for the join request; random when omitted
zh_Hans: 加入请求的固定确认 id；省略时随机
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the console's 0x58 RTT requests. Sixteen bytes at version 4, and the reply echoes the seven bytes nothing has read yet
zh_Hans: 应答控制台的 0x58 RTT 请求。版本 4 下为十六字节，回复会回显那七个尚未被读取的字节
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: acknowledge the 0x7C reliable window. The pass signal is the retransmits STOPPING and the sequence ids moving on
zh_Hans: 确认 0x7C 可靠窗口。通过的信号是重传停止，并且序列号继续前进
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: which of the 32 ack slots to fill; "all" (the default) fills every one, because only the slot at some station index is read and whose index it is has not been settled. "0" is the console, "1" is us
zh_Hans: 填充 32 个 ack 槽位中的哪些；“all”（默认）会全部填充，因为只会读取某个站点索引处的槽位，而具体是哪个索引尚未确定。“0” 是主机，“1” 是我们
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the header's own 'lowest sequence pending ack'. We have sent nothing on this protocol, so 1 (the next id we would use) and 0 are both readings; the console itself sends 1 while waiting on its own first message
zh_Hans: 头部自身的“待确认的最低序列号”。我们在该协议上尚未发送任何内容，因此 1（我们将要使用的下一个 id）和 0 都说得通；主机自身在等待自己的第一条消息时发送 1
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the station BITMAP on 0x58 and 0x7C. The console sends 2 to us, station index 1; 1 is the bit for station 0, which is the console
zh_Hans: 0x58 和 0x7C 上的站点 BITMAP。主机向我们发送 2，即站点索引 1；1 是站点 0（也就是主机）的位
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send APPLICATION DATA once the mesh is up - the first of the project. The payload as hex; "610000000a00" is the six bytes the console repeats at us on 0x7C. Nothing is sent without this flag
zh_Hans: mesh 建立后发送 APPLICATION DATA - 本项目的第一次。载荷以十六进制给出；"610000000a00" 就是主机在 0x7C 上反复发给我们的六个字节。没有这个标志就什么也不发送
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: 0x80 (the broadcast reliable window, the default: it asks us for sequence 1 once a second) or 0x7c (the unicast one, which has never had an ack to send us because it has never had our data)
zh_Hans: 0x80（广播可靠窗口，默认值：它每秒向我们请求一次序列 1）或 0x7c（单播窗口，它从未有 ack 可发给我们，因为它从未收到过我们的数据）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the sequence id. 1 is what both windows ask for; the first message also carries FLAG_IS_INITIALIZED and DEFINES where the stream starts
zh_Hans: 序列 id。两个窗口都要求 1；第一条消息还会携带 FLAG_IS_INITIALIZED，并定义流的起始位置
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the stream id. 0 is what the console sends on both protocols
zh_Hans: 流 id。0 是主机在两个协议上发送的值
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the header's destination list. "console" names its station constant id, which is what its own broadcast acks do to us; "none" sends count 0, which 0x01859578 never filters and every 0x7C message carries. "auto" mirrors the console per protocol: none on 0x7C, the console on 0x80
zh_Hans: 头部的目标列表。“console” 指定其站点常量 id，即它自己的广播 ack 对我们的做法；“none” 发送计数 0，0x01859578 从不过滤该值，且每条 0x7C 消息都会携带它。“auto” 按协议镜像主机：0x7C 上为 none，0x80 上为 console
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: compress the message, the way the console compresses every 0x80 message it sends. The flag is the Pia message's (0x10 at version 4), so this is free either way - and it is one variable, so sweep it alone
zh_Hans: 压缩消息，就像控制台压缩它发送的每条 0x80 消息那样。该标志属于 Pia 消息（版本 4 下为 0x10），所以怎么选都没有代价 —— 而且它只是一个变量，所以单独扫它
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the Pia message port. The console sends its 0x80 acks on 0 AND 1, each packet carrying both; "0,1" mirrors that
zh_Hans: Pia 消息端口。主机在 0 和 1 上发送它的 0x80 ack，每个数据包同时携带两者；“0,1” 即是照此模拟
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how long to wait for the station handshake before giving up on sending
zh_Hans: 等待站点握手多久后放弃发送
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: seconds after acceptance before the first data message, so the mesh join and the RTT exchange are already running when it lands
zh_Hans: 接受之后多少秒才发第一条数据消息，这样它到达时 mesh 加入与 RTT 交换已经在进行
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: a SECOND stream, on --send2-protocol, sent once the console says --send2-trigger. `60ea000012020801` is BlockDataHolder{imReady:true}, which the console says on 0x80 and waits on
zh_Hans: 经由 --send2-protocol 的第二条流，在主机发出 --send2-trigger 后发送。`60ea000012020801` 是 BlockDataHolder{imReady:true}，主机在 0x80 上发出它并等待它
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: wait for this payload on --send2-protocol before sending; omit to send as soon as the mesh is up
zh_Hans: 发送前先在 --send2-protocol 上等待该负载；省略则在网格一建立就发送
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after our offer is acknowledged, send imReady on the TRADE holder (20030). The console has never sent these bytes and the published client waits for them before it offers, so it may be our turn to say them
zh_Hans: 我们的提供被确认后，在 TRADE holder（20030）上发送 imReady。主机从未发送过这些字节，而已发布的客户端会在提供之前等待它们，所以也许轮到我们来说
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the trade RPC on its OWN Pia port with its own reliable window. The console sends them on 0x7C port 1; an answer on port 0 lands on a window it does not read them on
zh_Hans: 在交换 RPC 自己的 Pia 端口上、用它自己的可靠窗口来应答。控制台在 0x7C 端口 1 上发送它们；在端口 0 上应答会落在它不读取它们的窗口上
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the console's MIGRATION_START on 0x18 port 1 with a MIGRATION_RESPONSE. `440001` arrives there only when the player accepts, and the console goes silent on every window afterwards: the last thing it asks for is two bytes of mesh, not application data
zh_Hans: 用 MIGRATION_RESPONSE 应答控制台在 0x18 端口 1 上的 MIGRATION_START。只有玩家接受时 `440001` 才会到达那里，而之后控制台会在所有窗口上静默：它最后请求的是两字节的 mesh，而不是应用数据
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: when the hosting console leaves, ack its update session carrying the host-migration state and leave the network on its START_HOST_MIGRATION, as its own clients do; each step waits 10 s unanswered
zh_Hans: 当主持主机离开时，对其携带主机迁移状态的更新会话进行 ack，并在其 START_HOST_MIGRATION 时离开网络，如同它自己的客户端所做；每一步在无应答时等待 10 秒
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: what to send when the console migrates the mesh. "auto" sends MIGRATION_FINISH when the start names US as the next host and a MIGRATION_RESPONSE when it names anyone else, which is what the binary says. "response" always answers 0x48, for comparison
zh_Hans: 主机迁移网格时发送的内容。“auto” 在开始消息指定我们为下一个主机时发送 MIGRATION_FINISH，指定其他任何对象时发送 MIGRATION_RESPONSE，这与二进制中的行为一致。“response” 则始终应答 0x48，用于对比
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after our offer is acknowledged, send `ping` on content N's 10000-base holder for each N - `382700000a00` for 40, which is exactly the opener nxldn-lab's client sends to start the confirmation phase, rebuilt here from our own content registry rather than copied
zh_Hans: 我们的提供被确认后，对每个 N 在 content N 的 10000 基址 holder 上发送 `ping`，例如 40 对应 `382700000a00`；这正是 nxldn-lab 的客户端用来开始确认阶段的开场消息，此处根据我们自己的 content 注册表重建，而不是照抄
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: when the CONFIRMATION envelope (40040) sends a four-byte status whose body ends `0100` - the same cue the selection content sends before its Pokemon - reply with SyncSaveDataHolder{syncCommand{data:N}} on that content's 10000-base holder, id 10040, reliable port 0, and answer the status itself on port 1. Content 40 takes a command and not a Pokemon: its parser 0x010df6d0 accepts one submessage carrying one int32. Its own machine sends 0, 1, 2 and 3 in that order (swsh_trade.SYNC_COMMANDS)
zh_Hans: 当 CONFIRMATION 信封（40040）发送主体以 `0100` 结尾的四字节状态时——这与选择内容在其宝可梦之前发送的提示相同——在该内容以 10000 为基的 holder 上、id 10040、可靠端口 0 回复 SyncSaveDataHolder{syncCommand{data:N}}，并在端口 1 上应答状态本身。内容 40 接受的是命令而不是宝可梦：其解析器 0x010df6d0 接受一条携带一个 int32 的子消息。它自身的机器按该顺序发送 0、1、2 和 3（swsh_trade.SYNC_COMMANDS）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the confirmation content's four-byte steps with phase N in the LOW u16 instead of echoing the console's own. The console reads its phase out of exactly those bytes (`0x006d6490` stores them, `0x006d3260` reads them), and every step this project has sent so far echoed the value back unchanged
zh_Hans: 用低 u16 中的阶段 N 来应答确认内容的四字节步骤，而不是回显控制台自己的值。控制台正是从这些字节读出其阶段（`0x006d6490` 存储它们，`0x006d3260` 读取它们），而本项目迄今发送的每个步骤都是把该值原样回显
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: while the confirmation ladder waits on the console, send our 40040 pair again every SECONDS with its clock advanced to the present. 0 is off
zh_TW: 交換確認流程等待主機回應時，每隔 SECONDS 秒重新傳送 pokeldn 成對的 40040 訊息，並將訊息中的時脈推進至目前時間；設為 0 可停用
seed: 交换确认流程等待主机回应时，每隔 SECONDS 秒重新传送 pokeldn 成对的 40040 信息，并将信息中的时脉推进至目前时间；设为 0 可禁用
zh_Hans: 确认阶梯等待主机回应期间，每隔 SECONDS 秒重新发送我们那对 40040 消息，并将其中的时钟推进到当前时间。0 表示关闭

en: once the confirmation ladder has produced its first step, end the run as soon as SECONDS pass with no NEW step body: stop transmitting, drop the link and let the console report a lost connection. Holding a stalled ladder open with acks instead makes the game declare the TRADE failed, which costs the player about an hour. Nothing but acks follows the last step body. 0 is off and the hold runs in full.
zh_Hans: 一旦确认阶梯产生了它的第一个步骤，就在 SECONDS 过去而没有新的步骤体之后立即结束本次运行：停止发送、断开连接，让实机报告连接丢失。用确认把停滞的阶梯维持住，反而会让游戏宣布交换失败，这会让玩家损失大约一小时。最后一个步骤体之后除了确认没有别的内容。0 表示关闭，此时会完整地保持等待。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the handshake form of --confirm-command: send the NEXT of these on each new four-byte body the confirmation content puts on elementId 20000. Content 40's own machine sends 0,1,2,3 and parks after each; one command buys two rungs and then the ladder stops
zh_Hans: --confirm-command 的握手形式：每当确认内容在 elementId 20000 上放入新的四字节主体时，依次发送这些值中的下一个。内容 40 自身的机器发送 0,1,2,3，并在每步之后停留；一条命令可推进两级，之后阶梯便停止
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after the CONFIRMATION content answers our syncCommand with a hash, re-arm the 40040 pair and send BOTH members again at this clock delta - the move --selection-final-delta makes on 40050, which carries the selection phase past its own hash
zh_Hans: CONFIRMATION content 用哈希应答我们的 syncCommand 后，重新装载 40040 这一对，并以该时钟增量再次发送两个成员，这正是 --selection-final-delta 在 40050 上所做的动作，可让选择阶段越过它自己的哈希
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after the selection HASH is answered, send the 40050 pair AGAIN - both members - at this clock delta. nxldn-lab's `selection_final_delta` is 9 (nxldn-lab's `selection_final_delta`). --rpc-pair latches per envelope, so the second pair needs the latch cleared. 0 is off
zh_Hans: 选择 HASH 被应答后，以该时钟增量再次发送 40050 对的两个成员。nxldn-lab 的 `selection_final_delta` 为 9（nxldn-lab 的 `selection_final_delta`）。--rpc-pair 按封套锁存，因此第二对需要先清除锁存。0 表示关闭
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: make --open-content send our PK8 on the 10000-base holder instead of an empty `ping`. The ping opens content 50 and is taken as our Pokemon: the console reaches the confirmation phase and asks the player to trade theirs for an egg. Same moment, same holder, a Pokemon in it
zh_Hans: 让 --open-content 在 10000 基址的 holder 上发送我们的 PK8，而不是空的 `ping`。ping 会打开 content 50 并被当作我们的宝可梦：实机因此进入确认阶段，并要求玩家用他们的宝可梦换一颗蛋。同一时刻、同一 holder，里面放一只宝可梦
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send these box commands the moment MIGRATION_START arrives - the only signal that says the player pressed accept. The console keeps acking for about five seconds after it
zh_Hans: MIGRATION_START 一到就发送这些 box 命令 - 这是唯一表示玩家按下接受的信号。主机在此之后还会持续确认约五秒
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: seconds between the queued post-offer payloads. Spread them so the sweep spans the accept: the console tears down on the accept, not on a timer, so commands sent inside a couple of seconds all land before it
zh_Hans: 排队的 offer 后载荷之间的秒数。把它们拉开，让轮扫覆盖到接受：主机是在接受时才拆除，而不是靠计时器，因此几秒内发出的命令都会在拆除前到达
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: when the console follows its selection-phase Pokemon with the status whose body ends `0100`, offer OUR Pokemon on that content's 10000-base holder (id 10050) on reliable port 0 and answer the status on port 1
zh_Hans: 当主机在选择阶段宝可梦之后跟随主体以 `0100` 结尾的状态时，在该内容以 10000 为基的 holder（id 10050）上、可靠端口 0 提供我们的宝可梦，并在端口 1 上应答该状态
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: once a hash body has been answered, open content N's phase by sending the two-member RPC pair for it (40 is the confirmation). A pair is the only shape that opens a phase on this console: 40030 opened the offer and 40050 the selection. A bare content ping (`382700000a00`) and a bare sync-120 ping (`780000000a00`) are both ignored
zh_Hans: hash 体应答之后，发送针对它的双成员 RPC 对来打开 content N 的阶段（40 是确认）。在这台实机上，只有成对的形式才能打开一个阶段：40030 打开了提供，40050 打开了选择。单纯的内容 ping（`382700000a00`）和单纯的 sync-120 ping（`780000000a00`）都会被忽略
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: queue a sync on holder N right behind our selection offer, in the branch that actually runs when --selection-offer is on. --sync-after-hash cannot fire there: this one can
zh_Hans: 把 holder N 上的 sync 紧跟在我们的选择提供之后排队，放在 --selection-offer 打开时真正执行的那条分支里。--sync-after-hash 在那里无法触发：这个可以
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: which SyncPingDataHolder field --sync-after-hash sends: 1 ping, 2 pingReply, 3 pingSynced (`780000001a00`, the one the trace records)
zh_Hans: --sync-after-hash 发送哪个 SyncPingDataHolder 字段：1 ping、2 pingReply、3 pingSynced（`780000001a00`，即跟踪记录中的那个）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: once a hash body has been answered, send `ping` on sync holder N (120 is the confirmation's) on port 0. The console drives 97, 60000, 110 and 130 itself and opens the selection phase when 130's pingSynced lands; it never sends 120. A phase follows its sync, not a content ping
zh_Hans: hash 体应答之后，在端口 0 上对 sync holder N 发送 `ping`（120 是确认用的那个）。实机会自己驱动 97、60000、110 和 130，并在 130 的 pingSynced 到达时打开选择阶段；它从不发送 120。阶段跟随的是它的 sync，而不是内容 ping
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: once a hash body has been answered, `ping` content N's 10000-base holder on port 0 to open the next phase - 40 is the confirmation, so this sends `382700000a00`. The console stops sending 40050 once the hash answer lands and says nothing further; Pia retransmits anything it still waits on, so that silence means satisfied and the next phase needs opening
zh_Hans: hash 体应答之后，在端口 0 上对 content N 的 10000 基址 holder 执行 `ping` 以打开下一阶段——40 就是确认，因此这会发送 `382700000a00`。hash 应答到达后，实机就停止发送 40050 且不再多说什么；Pia 会重传它仍在等待的一切，所以这种静默意味着已满足，下一阶段需要主动打开
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer every DISTINCT (envelope, base, field-5 body) in the 40000 band once, on top of the opening pair. The clock advances on every message so the payload cannot be the key, but the body can: `00000000` and `000018fc` are the openers and anything else is new. A per-envelope guard stops answering at the hash body and stalls there
zh_Hans: 对 40000 频段内每个不同的 (envelope, base, field-5 body) 只应答一次，此外还覆盖开局的那一对。每条消息的时钟都会前进，所以载荷不能当作键，但消息体可以：`00000000` 和 `000018fc` 是开局消息，其他任何值都是新的。按 envelope 设置的守卫会在哈希体处停止应答并卡在那里
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the console's 40030 RPC as the PAIR it is: collect both members one per base, 10000 then 20000, keyed on the BASE FIELD. `payload[5] in (0x19, 0x1A)` is the inner length and moves with the sender's station-id varint (0x1A/0x1B on some consoles). Send both once in that order and nothing more on this window; `said_by_port` keeps only the last payload, so a mirror sends one member repeatedly and never the other
zh_Hans: 把控制台的 40030 RPC 当作它本来的一对来应答：每个 base 收集一个成员，先 10000 后 20000，以 BASE 字段为键。`payload[5] in (0x19, 0x1A)` 是内层长度，并随发送方的 station-id varint 变化（某些控制台上是 0x1A/0x1B）。按该顺序各发送一次，此窗口内不再发送其他内容；`said_by_port` 只保留最后一个载荷，所以镜像会反复发送其中一个成员，永远不发另一个
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: `ping` content N's 10000-base holder at the 0x84 snapshot ack, before either side offers. The console's box send is gated on a ready bool at content+0x4c that only `0x010ce040` sets, on a zero result code; until then every command the game tries to send is parked in content+0x48. A parked command that does not match the next one sets the error byte +0x4d, and `0x010c9bb0` turns that into trade state 9: abort, with nothing on the application layer
zh_Hans: 在 0x84 快照 ack 时、双方都尚未发起提供之前，对 content N 的 10000 基址 holder 执行 `ping`。主机的盒子发送受 content+0x4c 处的一个 ready 布尔值控制，只有 `0x010ce040` 在结果码为 0 时会设置它；在此之前，游戏尝试发送的每条命令都停在 content+0x48。停下的命令若与下一条不匹配，就会置位错误字节 +0x4d，而 `0x010c9bb0` 会把它变成交换状态 9：中止，应用层上没有任何提示
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send these box commands as soon as the console acks our 0x84 snapshot - BEFORE either side offers a Pokemon. The game sends command 3 exactly once, on the first frame after its trade session is built and only when the role bit at session+0x419 is clear (0x010c9bb0), so one of the two sides owes the other an opener before anything else happens. Sent after both offers instead, the console leaves while the player is still picking
zh_Hans: 主机一确认我们的 0x84 快照就发送这些 box 命令 - 早于任一方提供宝可梦。游戏只在交换会话建立后的第一帧、且 session+0x419 处的角色位为 clear（0x010c9bb0）时发送一次命令 3，因此两方中总有一方要在其他事情发生前先给开场。若改为在双方都 offer 之后才发送，主机会在玩家还在挑选时就离开
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after our offer is acknowledged, send boxSyncStateCommand{data:N} on the trade holder for each N in turn, one per acknowledged sequence. 20030 is a BoxSyncStateDataHolder and its field 2 is a command enum; this project 1 offers and 2 withdraws; 4 confirms and 5 withdraws the confirmation
zh_Hans: 我们的提供被确认后，依次对每个 N 在 trade holder 上发送 boxSyncStateCommand{data:N}，每个已确认的序列发一条。20030 是 BoxSyncStateDataHolder，其字段 2 是命令枚举；本项目 1 表示提供、2 表示撤回；4 表示确认、5 表示撤回确认
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: replace the three ids at the front of the snapshot's profile (pseudo device id, account Uid, network service account id). They are the console's own, handed back unchanged otherwise
zh_Hans: 替换快照 profile 开头的三个 id（伪设备 id、账号 Uid、网络服务账号 id）。它们属于实机自身，否则会原样交回
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --selection-offer, answer the console's selection status with our PK8 in field 5 (`body`) of a 40050 Data carrying OUR ownerId, on the RPC port, instead of a PokemonTradeDataHolder on 10050 port 0. Content 50's receive handler resolves the sender to a station index and drops silently when it cannot; the holder shape carries no owner
zh_Hans: 配合 --selection-offer：在 RPC 端口上用携带我们 ownerId 的 40050 Data 的第 5 个字段（`body`）放入我们的 PK8 来应答主机的选择状态，而不是在 10050 端口 0 上用 PokemonTradeDataHolder。Content 50 的接收处理程序会把发送方解析为站点索引，无法解析时静默丢弃；holder 形式不携带 owner
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send our PK8 as a Data on elementId 10000 and as a holder on the 30000-base id (30050), which every content registers. More than one variable at once
zh_Hans: 把我们的 PK8 作为 elementId 10000 上的 Data 发送，并作为 30000 基址 id（30050）上的 holder 发送，每个 content 都会注册它。可同时指定多个变量
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --selection-offer, answer the selection status with our PK8 as a PokemonTradeDataHolder on the 20000-base holder (id 20050), which is where the BOX phase's own Pokemon rides one content over. Overrides --selection-offer-mirror and --selection-offer-data
zh_Hans: 配合 --selection-offer：把我们的 PK8 作为 PokemonTradeDataHolder 放在基于 20000 的 holder（id 20050）上来应答选择状态，箱子阶段自己的宝可梦正是在它之上多一个 content 传输的。覆盖 --selection-offer-mirror 和 --selection-offer-data
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --selection-offer, answer the selection status with our PK8 in a 40050 carrying the console's OWN field set - syncId, clock, body, and neither elementId nor ownerId, which is how its own selection offer decodes. Overrides --selection-offer-data
zh_Hans: 配合 --selection-offer：把我们的 PK8 放进携带主机自身字段集的 40050 来应答选择状态 - 即 syncId、clock、body，且不含 elementId 和 ownerId，这正是它自己的选择提议被解码的方式。覆盖 --selection-offer-data
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: offer back the exact PK8 the console just offered us, unchanged, instead of one out of --send-snapshot. These bytes came out of its own save, so a run that still aborts rules the record out
zh_Hans: 原样回送实机刚提供给我们的那个 PK8，而不是从 --send-snapshot 里取一个。这些字节来自它自己的存档，所以如果运行仍然中止，就可以排除这条记录
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: put our PK8 in field 5 of the 40050 pair's second member. Content 50 is PokemonTradeDataHolder, the transfer; content 30 is the box exchange. A 344-byte PK8 rides that field
zh_Hans: 把我们的 PK8 放进 40050 对中第二个成员的字段 5。content 50 是 PokemonTradeDataHolder，即传输；content 30 是盒子交换。一个 344 字节的 PK8 就装在该字段里
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: WHEN to open the selection phase with a 40050 pair on 0x7c port 1. "offer" sends it as soon as our offer is acknowledged, the only window the console is still reading in; "migration" sends it on the migration start, after the console has stopped. The pair is the same envelope as the console's own 40030 at offset 50 with our station id; the builder reproduces its 40030 pair byte for byte
zh_Hans: 何时在 0x7c 端口 1 上用一对 40050 开始选择阶段。“offer”在我们的提供被确认后立即发送，这是主机仍在读取的唯一窗口；“migration”在迁移开始时发送，此时主机已经停止。这一对消息与主机自己的 40030 是同一个封套，位于偏移 50，并带我们的站点 id；构建器会逐字节复现它的 40030 对
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: once the migration makes us the host, broadcast UPDATE_MESH the way the console did: its own last one with the host index set to ours. The console stops sending these once it hands the role over, and the mesh is gone about 1.3 s later if nothing takes over
zh_Hans: 一旦迁移使我们成为主机，就像实机那样广播 UPDATE_MESH：用它最后发出的那条，并把主机索引设为我们的。实机在移交角色后就停止发送这些消息，如果没有任何一方接手，mesh 大约 1.3 s 后就会消失
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how often to broadcast it; the console sent one about every 2 s
zh_Hans: 多久广播一次；实机大约每 2 s 发送一次
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how often to retransmit the migration response until it is acked
zh_Hans: 每隔多久重传迁移响应，直到被确认
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer each payload the console sends ONCE instead of re-deriving an answer to its last payload every period. `said` never clears, so without this an offer goes out hundreds of times. The console sends each of its own messages once
zh_Hans: 对控制台发送的每个载荷只应答一次，而不是每个周期都为其上一个载荷重新推导答案。`said` 从不清空，所以没有这个选项时，一个提议会发出数百次。控制台自己的每条消息只发送一次
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: which party slot of --send-snapshot to offer back, 1-6; 0 offers nothing and only records what the console offers us
zh_TW: 要換回的 --send-snapshot 同行寶可夢位置，範圍 1-6；0 表示不提供寶可夢，只記錄主機提供的內容
seed: 要换回的 --send-snapshot 同行宝可梦位置，范围 1-6；0 表示不提供宝可梦，只记录主机提供的内容
zh_Hans: 回赠 --send-snapshot 的哪个队伍槽位，1-6；0 表示不提供任何内容，只记录主机提供给我们的内容

en: a .pk8 to put in --offer-slot in place of the snapshot's record: stored or party form, encrypted or PKHeX's decrypted export. Its OT name and ids become the snapshot's unless --offer-file-as-is. Repeatable, one per trade on the session: the console's player picks again from the box; the last serves every later trade
zh_TW: 以 .pk8 取代快照中 --offer-slot 的資料，可為盒子或同行格式、加密檔或 PKHeX 解密匯出檔。除非指定 --offer-file-as-is，否則會使用快照的初訓家名稱與 ID。可重複指定，依序用於各次交換；玩家需從盒子再次選擇，後續交換持續使用最後一筆
seed: 以 .pk8 取代快照中 --offer-slot 的数据，可为盒子或同行格式、加密档或 PKHeX 解密导出档。除非指定 --offer-file-as-is，否则会使用快照的初训家名称与 ID。可重复指定，依序用于各次交换；玩家需从盒子再次选择，后续交换持续使用最后一笔
zh_Hans: 用于 --offer-slot 并取代快照记录的 .pk8，可以是盒子或同行格式、加密文件或 PKHeX 解密导出文件。除非指定 --offer-file-as-is，否则会使用快照的初训家名称与 ID。可重复指定，会话中每次交换一条：主机的玩家会从盒子里重新选择；之后的所有交换都使用最后一条

en: after each trade, trade again and offer the Pokemon the console just sent, so one that evolves by trade evolves on the console; the player offers ours back (docs/architecture.md, Trade back)
zh_TW: 每次交換後再次交換，將主機剛送出的寶可夢換回，讓需要通訊進化的寶可夢在主機上進化；玩家需將本程式送出的寶可夢換回（docs/architecture.md，Trade back）
seed: 每次交换后再次交换，将主机刚送出的宝可梦换回，让需要通信进化的宝可梦在主机上进化；玩家需将本程序送出的宝可梦换回（docs/architecture.md，Trade back）
zh_Hans: 每次交换后再次交换，将主机刚送出的宝可梦换回，让需要通信进化的宝可梦在主机上进化；玩家需将本程序送出的宝可梦换回（docs/architecture.md，Trade back）

en: draw a new encryption constant and PID for every offered Pokemon
zh_TW: 為每隻提供的寶可夢重新產生加密常數與 PID
seed: 为每只提供的宝可梦重新产生加密常数与 PID
zh_Hans: 为每只被提议的宝可梦抽取新的加密常数和 PID

en: keep the file's own OT name and trainer ids
zh_Hans: 保留文件自带的初训家名和训练家 id
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after answering an RPC pair, send BOTH members again with the clock advanced by this much. The console advances its own pair's clock by 2 each burst (b41c, b61c, b81c). A repeated clock is a repeated state, so an answer that carries one clock never moves ours. 0 is off
zh_Hans: 应答一组 RPC 对之后，把时钟推进这么多再重新发送两个成员。主机会在每次突发时把自己那一对的时钟推进 2（b41c、b61c、b81c）。时钟重复就意味着状态重复，因此只带一个时钟的应答永远不会推动我们的时钟。0 表示关闭
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send our own 40050 pair the moment the console says id 130 pingSynced, before its own selection burst. nxldn-lab's client opens the selection phase this way and nothing here has ever opened one; the console sends 820000001a00 in our own captures 0.3 s before its 40050 burst
zh_Hans: 主机一报告 id 130 pingSynced 就发送我们自己的 40050 对，早于它自己的选择突发。nxldn-lab 的客户端就是这样开启选择阶段的，而这里的任何实现都从未开启过；在我们自己的抓包里，主机在其 40050 突发之前 0.3 s 发送 820000001a00
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: ACK the console's 0x84 fragments (kind 0x21, a contiguous base and a bitmask). Nothing here has ever acked this protocol, which is why the console retransmits one snapshot 19142 times and never moves on
zh_Hans: 对主机的 0x84 分片（类型 0x21，连续基址加位掩码）回 ACK。此前从未有实现确认过该协议，因此主机会把同一份快照重传 19142 次而始终不前进
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: a 3456-byte trade snapshot to send back on 0x84 once the console sends its own, or live (the default under --preset trade) for the console's own from this session. A short 2965-byte payload is inflated first. The identity is rewritten by --snapshot-name/-tid/-sid
zh_Hans: 一个 3456 字节的交换快照，在主机发送自己的快照后通过 0x84 发回；实时模式（--preset trade 下的默认）则发回本次会话中主机自己的快照。2965 字节的短负载会先解压。身份信息由 --snapshot-name/-tid/-sid 重写

en: the header's own 'lowest sequence pending ack'. We have sent nothing on this protocol, so 1 (the next id we would use) and 0 are both readings; the console itself sends 1 while waiting on its own first message

en: the station BITMAP on 0x58 and 0x7C. The console sends 2 to us, station index 1; 1 is the bit for station 0, which is the console

en: send APPLICATION DATA once the mesh is up - the first of the project. The payload as hex; "610000000a00" is the six bytes the console repeats at us on 0x7C. Nothing is sent without this flag
zh_Hans: mesh 建立后发送 APPLICATION DATA - 本项目的第一次。载荷以十六进制给出；"610000000a00" 就是主机在 0x7C 上反复发给我们的六个字节。没有这个标志就什么也不发送
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: 0x80 (the broadcast reliable window, the default: it asks us for sequence 1 once a second) or 0x7c (the unicast one, which has never had an ack to send us because it has never had our data)
zh_Hans: 0x80（广播可靠窗口，默认值：它每秒向我们请求一次序列 1）或 0x7c（单播窗口，它从未有 ack 可发给我们，因为它从未收到过我们的数据）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the sequence id. 1 is what both windows ask for; the first message also carries FLAG_IS_INITIALIZED and DEFINES where the stream starts
zh_Hans: 序列 id。两个窗口都要求 1；第一条消息还会携带 FLAG_IS_INITIALIZED，并定义流的起始位置
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the stream id. 0 is what the console sends on both protocols
zh_Hans: 流 id。0 是主机在两个协议上发送的值
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the header's destination list. "console" names its station constant id, which is what its own broadcast acks do to us; "none" sends count 0, which 0x01859578 never filters and every 0x7C message carries. "auto" mirrors the console per protocol: none on 0x7C, the console on 0x80
zh_Hans: 头部的目标列表。“console” 指定其站点常量 id，即它自己的广播 ack 对我们的做法；“none” 发送计数 0，0x01859578 从不过滤该值，且每条 0x7C 消息都会携带它。“auto” 按协议镜像主机：0x7C 上为 none，0x80 上为 console
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: compress the message, the way the console compresses every 0x80 message it sends. The flag is the Pia message's (0x10 at version 4), so this is free either way - and it is one variable, so sweep it alone
zh_Hans: 压缩消息，就像控制台压缩它发送的每条 0x80 消息那样。该标志属于 Pia 消息（版本 4 下为 0x10），所以怎么选都没有代价 —— 而且它只是一个变量，所以单独扫它
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the Pia message port. The console sends its 0x80 acks on 0 AND 1, each packet carrying both; "0,1" mirrors that
zh_Hans: Pia 消息端口。主机在 0 和 1 上发送它的 0x80 ack，每个数据包同时携带两者；“0,1” 即是照此模拟
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how long to wait for the station handshake before giving up on sending
zh_Hans: 等待站点握手多久后放弃发送
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: seconds after acceptance before the first data message, so the mesh join and the RTT exchange are already running when it lands
zh_Hans: 接受之后多少秒才发第一条数据消息，这样它到达时 mesh 加入与 RTT 交换已经在进行
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: a SECOND stream, on --send2-protocol, sent once the console says --send2-trigger. `60ea000012020801` is BlockDataHolder{imReady:true}, which the console says on 0x80 and waits on
zh_Hans: 经由 --send2-protocol 的第二条流，在主机发出 --send2-trigger 后发送。`60ea000012020801` 是 BlockDataHolder{imReady:true}，主机在 0x80 上发出它并等待它
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: wait for this payload on --send2-protocol before sending; omit to send as soon as the mesh is up
zh_Hans: 发送前先在 --send2-protocol 上等待该负载；省略则在网格一建立就发送
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after our offer is acknowledged, send imReady on the TRADE holder (20030). The console has never sent these bytes and the published client waits for them before it offers, so it may be our turn to say them
zh_Hans: 我们的提供被确认后，在 TRADE holder（20030）上发送 imReady。主机从未发送过这些字节，而已发布的客户端会在提供之前等待它们，所以也许轮到我们来说
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the trade RPC on its OWN Pia port with its own reliable window. The console sends them on 0x7C port 1; an answer on port 0 lands on a window it does not read them on
zh_Hans: 在交换 RPC 自己的 Pia 端口上、用它自己的可靠窗口来应答。控制台在 0x7C 端口 1 上发送它们；在端口 0 上应答会落在它不读取它们的窗口上
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the console's MIGRATION_START on 0x18 port 1 with a MIGRATION_RESPONSE. `440001` arrives there only when the player accepts, and the console goes silent on every window afterwards: the last thing it asks for is two bytes of mesh, not application data
zh_Hans: 用 MIGRATION_RESPONSE 应答控制台在 0x18 端口 1 上的 MIGRATION_START。只有玩家接受时 `440001` 才会到达那里，而之后控制台会在所有窗口上静默：它最后请求的是两字节的 mesh，而不是应用数据
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: when the hosting console leaves, ack its update session carrying the host-migration state and leave the network on its START_HOST_MIGRATION, as its own clients do; each step waits 10 s unanswered
zh_Hans: 当主持主机离开时，对其携带主机迁移状态的更新会话进行 ack，并在其 START_HOST_MIGRATION 时离开网络，如同它自己的客户端所做；每一步在无应答时等待 10 秒
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: what to send when the console migrates the mesh. "auto" sends MIGRATION_FINISH when the start names US as the next host and a MIGRATION_RESPONSE when it names anyone else, which is what the binary says. "response" always answers 0x48, for comparison
zh_Hans: 主机迁移网格时发送的内容。“auto” 在开始消息指定我们为下一个主机时发送 MIGRATION_FINISH，指定其他任何对象时发送 MIGRATION_RESPONSE，这与二进制中的行为一致。“response” 则始终应答 0x48，用于对比
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after our offer is acknowledged, send `ping` on content N's 10000-base holder for each N - `382700000a00` for 40, which is exactly the opener nxldn-lab's client sends to start the confirmation phase, rebuilt here from our own content registry rather than copied
zh_Hans: 我们的提供被确认后，对每个 N 在 content N 的 10000 基址 holder 上发送 `ping`，例如 40 对应 `382700000a00`；这正是 nxldn-lab 的客户端用来开始确认阶段的开场消息，此处根据我们自己的 content 注册表重建，而不是照抄
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: when the CONFIRMATION envelope (40040) sends a four-byte status whose body ends `0100` - the same cue the selection content sends before its Pokemon - reply with SyncSaveDataHolder{syncCommand{data:N}} on that content's 10000-base holder, id 10040, reliable port 0, and answer the status itself on port 1. Content 40 takes a command and not a Pokemon: its parser 0x010df6d0 accepts one submessage carrying one int32. Its own machine sends 0, 1, 2 and 3 in that order (swsh_trade.SYNC_COMMANDS)
zh_Hans: 当 CONFIRMATION 信封（40040）发送主体以 `0100` 结尾的四字节状态时——这与选择内容在其宝可梦之前发送的提示相同——在该内容以 10000 为基的 holder 上、id 10040、可靠端口 0 回复 SyncSaveDataHolder{syncCommand{data:N}}，并在端口 1 上应答状态本身。内容 40 接受的是命令而不是宝可梦：其解析器 0x010df6d0 接受一条携带一个 int32 的子消息。它自身的机器按该顺序发送 0、1、2 和 3（swsh_trade.SYNC_COMMANDS）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the confirmation content's four-byte steps with phase N in the LOW u16 instead of echoing the console's own. The console reads its phase out of exactly those bytes (`0x006d6490` stores them, `0x006d3260` reads them), and every step this project has sent so far echoed the value back unchanged
zh_Hans: 用低 u16 中的阶段 N 来应答确认内容的四字节步骤，而不是回显控制台自己的值。控制台正是从这些字节读出其阶段（`0x006d6490` 存储它们，`0x006d3260` 读取它们），而本项目迄今发送的每个步骤都是把该值原样回显
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: while the confirmation ladder waits on the console, send our 40040 pair again every SECONDS with its clock advanced to the present. 0 is off
zh_TW: 交換確認流程等待主機回應時，每隔 SECONDS 秒重新傳送 pokeldn 成對的 40040 訊息，並將訊息中的時脈推進至目前時間；設為 0 可停用
seed: 交换确认流程等待主机回应时，每隔 SECONDS 秒重新传送 pokeldn 成对的 40040 信息，并将信息中的时脉推进至目前时间；设为 0 可禁用
zh_Hans: 确认阶梯等待主机回应期间，每隔 SECONDS 秒重新发送我们那对 40040 消息，并将其中的时钟推进到当前时间。0 表示关闭

en: once the confirmation ladder has produced its first step, end the run as soon as SECONDS pass with no NEW step body: stop transmitting, drop the link and let the console report a lost connection. Holding a stalled ladder open with acks instead makes the game declare the TRADE failed, which costs the player about an hour. Nothing but acks follows the last step body. 0 is off and the hold runs in full.
zh_Hans: 一旦确认阶梯产生了它的第一个步骤，就在 SECONDS 过去而没有新的步骤体之后立即结束本次运行：停止发送、断开连接，让实机报告连接丢失。用确认把停滞的阶梯维持住，反而会让游戏宣布交换失败，这会让玩家损失大约一小时。最后一个步骤体之后除了确认没有别的内容。0 表示关闭，此时会完整地保持等待。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the handshake form of --confirm-command: send the NEXT of these on each new four-byte body the confirmation content puts on elementId 20000. Content 40's own machine sends 0,1,2,3 and parks after each; one command buys two rungs and then the ladder stops
zh_Hans: --confirm-command 的握手形式：每当确认内容在 elementId 20000 上放入新的四字节主体时，依次发送这些值中的下一个。内容 40 自身的机器发送 0,1,2,3，并在每步之后停留；一条命令可推进两级，之后阶梯便停止
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after the CONFIRMATION content answers our syncCommand with a hash, re-arm the 40040 pair and send BOTH members again at this clock delta - the move --selection-final-delta makes on 40050, which carries the selection phase past its own hash
zh_Hans: CONFIRMATION content 用哈希应答我们的 syncCommand 后，重新装载 40040 这一对，并以该时钟增量再次发送两个成员，这正是 --selection-final-delta 在 40050 上所做的动作，可让选择阶段越过它自己的哈希
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after the selection HASH is answered, send the 40050 pair AGAIN - both members - at this clock delta. nxldn-lab's `selection_final_delta` is 9 (nxldn-lab's `selection_final_delta`). --rpc-pair latches per envelope, so the second pair needs the latch cleared. 0 is off
zh_Hans: 选择 HASH 被应答后，以该时钟增量再次发送 40050 对的两个成员。nxldn-lab 的 `selection_final_delta` 为 9（nxldn-lab 的 `selection_final_delta`）。--rpc-pair 按封套锁存，因此第二对需要先清除锁存。0 表示关闭
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: make --open-content send our PK8 on the 10000-base holder instead of an empty `ping`. The ping opens content 50 and is taken as our Pokemon: the console reaches the confirmation phase and asks the player to trade theirs for an egg. Same moment, same holder, a Pokemon in it
zh_Hans: 让 --open-content 在 10000 基址的 holder 上发送我们的 PK8，而不是空的 `ping`。ping 会打开 content 50 并被当作我们的宝可梦：实机因此进入确认阶段，并要求玩家用他们的宝可梦换一颗蛋。同一时刻、同一 holder，里面放一只宝可梦
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send these box commands the moment MIGRATION_START arrives - the only signal that says the player pressed accept. The console keeps acking for about five seconds after it
zh_Hans: MIGRATION_START 一到就发送这些 box 命令 - 这是唯一表示玩家按下接受的信号。主机在此之后还会持续确认约五秒
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: seconds between the queued post-offer payloads. Spread them so the sweep spans the accept: the console tears down on the accept, not on a timer, so commands sent inside a couple of seconds all land before it
zh_Hans: 排队的 offer 后载荷之间的秒数。把它们拉开，让轮扫覆盖到接受：主机是在接受时才拆除，而不是靠计时器，因此几秒内发出的命令都会在拆除前到达
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: when the console follows its selection-phase Pokemon with the status whose body ends `0100`, offer OUR Pokemon on that content's 10000-base holder (id 10050) on reliable port 0 and answer the status on port 1
zh_Hans: 当主机在选择阶段宝可梦之后跟随主体以 `0100` 结尾的状态时，在该内容以 10000 为基的 holder（id 10050）上、可靠端口 0 提供我们的宝可梦，并在端口 1 上应答该状态
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: once a hash body has been answered, open content N's phase by sending the two-member RPC pair for it (40 is the confirmation). A pair is the only shape that opens a phase on this console: 40030 opened the offer and 40050 the selection. A bare content ping (`382700000a00`) and a bare sync-120 ping (`780000000a00`) are both ignored
zh_Hans: hash 体应答之后，发送针对它的双成员 RPC 对来打开 content N 的阶段（40 是确认）。在这台实机上，只有成对的形式才能打开一个阶段：40030 打开了提供，40050 打开了选择。单纯的内容 ping（`382700000a00`）和单纯的 sync-120 ping（`780000000a00`）都会被忽略
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: queue a sync on holder N right behind our selection offer, in the branch that actually runs when --selection-offer is on. --sync-after-hash cannot fire there: this one can
zh_Hans: 把 holder N 上的 sync 紧跟在我们的选择提供之后排队，放在 --selection-offer 打开时真正执行的那条分支里。--sync-after-hash 在那里无法触发：这个可以
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: which SyncPingDataHolder field --sync-after-hash sends: 1 ping, 2 pingReply, 3 pingSynced (`780000001a00`, the one the trace records)
zh_Hans: --sync-after-hash 发送哪个 SyncPingDataHolder 字段：1 ping、2 pingReply、3 pingSynced（`780000001a00`，即跟踪记录中的那个）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: once a hash body has been answered, send `ping` on sync holder N (120 is the confirmation's) on port 0. The console drives 97, 60000, 110 and 130 itself and opens the selection phase when 130's pingSynced lands; it never sends 120. A phase follows its sync, not a content ping
zh_Hans: hash 体应答之后，在端口 0 上对 sync holder N 发送 `ping`（120 是确认用的那个）。实机会自己驱动 97、60000、110 和 130，并在 130 的 pingSynced 到达时打开选择阶段；它从不发送 120。阶段跟随的是它的 sync，而不是内容 ping
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: once a hash body has been answered, `ping` content N's 10000-base holder on port 0 to open the next phase - 40 is the confirmation, so this sends `382700000a00`. The console stops sending 40050 once the hash answer lands and says nothing further; Pia retransmits anything it still waits on, so that silence means satisfied and the next phase needs opening
zh_Hans: hash 体应答之后，在端口 0 上对 content N 的 10000 基址 holder 执行 `ping` 以打开下一阶段——40 就是确认，因此这会发送 `382700000a00`。hash 应答到达后，实机就停止发送 40050 且不再多说什么；Pia 会重传它仍在等待的一切，所以这种静默意味着已满足，下一阶段需要主动打开
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer every DISTINCT (envelope, base, field-5 body) in the 40000 band once, on top of the opening pair. The clock advances on every message so the payload cannot be the key, but the body can: `00000000` and `000018fc` are the openers and anything else is new. A per-envelope guard stops answering at the hash body and stalls there
zh_Hans: 对 40000 频段内每个不同的 (envelope, base, field-5 body) 只应答一次，此外还覆盖开局的那一对。每条消息的时钟都会前进，所以载荷不能当作键，但消息体可以：`00000000` 和 `000018fc` 是开局消息，其他任何值都是新的。按 envelope 设置的守卫会在哈希体处停止应答并卡在那里
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the console's 40030 RPC as the PAIR it is: collect both members one per base, 10000 then 20000, keyed on the BASE FIELD. `payload[5] in (0x19, 0x1A)` is the inner length and moves with the sender's station-id varint (0x1A/0x1B on some consoles). Send both once in that order and nothing more on this window; `said_by_port` keeps only the last payload, so a mirror sends one member repeatedly and never the other
zh_Hans: 把控制台的 40030 RPC 当作它本来的一对来应答：每个 base 收集一个成员，先 10000 后 20000，以 BASE 字段为键。`payload[5] in (0x19, 0x1A)` 是内层长度，并随发送方的 station-id varint 变化（某些控制台上是 0x1A/0x1B）。按该顺序各发送一次，此窗口内不再发送其他内容；`said_by_port` 只保留最后一个载荷，所以镜像会反复发送其中一个成员，永远不发另一个
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: `ping` content N's 10000-base holder at the 0x84 snapshot ack, before either side offers. The console's box send is gated on a ready bool at content+0x4c that only `0x010ce040` sets, on a zero result code; until then every command the game tries to send is parked in content+0x48. A parked command that does not match the next one sets the error byte +0x4d, and `0x010c9bb0` turns that into trade state 9: abort, with nothing on the application layer
zh_Hans: 在 0x84 快照 ack 时、双方都尚未发起提供之前，对 content N 的 10000 基址 holder 执行 `ping`。主机的盒子发送受 content+0x4c 处的一个 ready 布尔值控制，只有 `0x010ce040` 在结果码为 0 时会设置它；在此之前，游戏尝试发送的每条命令都停在 content+0x48。停下的命令若与下一条不匹配，就会置位错误字节 +0x4d，而 `0x010c9bb0` 会把它变成交换状态 9：中止，应用层上没有任何提示
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send these box commands as soon as the console acks our 0x84 snapshot - BEFORE either side offers a Pokemon. The game sends command 3 exactly once, on the first frame after its trade session is built and only when the role bit at session+0x419 is clear (0x010c9bb0), so one of the two sides owes the other an opener before anything else happens. Sent after both offers instead, the console leaves while the player is still picking
zh_Hans: 主机一确认我们的 0x84 快照就发送这些 box 命令 - 早于任一方提供宝可梦。游戏只在交换会话建立后的第一帧、且 session+0x419 处的角色位为 clear（0x010c9bb0）时发送一次命令 3，因此两方中总有一方要在其他事情发生前先给开场。若改为在双方都 offer 之后才发送，主机会在玩家还在挑选时就离开
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after our offer is acknowledged, send boxSyncStateCommand{data:N} on the trade holder for each N in turn, one per acknowledged sequence. 20030 is a BoxSyncStateDataHolder and its field 2 is a command enum; this project 1 offers and 2 withdraws; 4 confirms and 5 withdraws the confirmation
zh_Hans: 我们的提供被确认后，依次对每个 N 在 trade holder 上发送 boxSyncStateCommand{data:N}，每个已确认的序列发一条。20030 是 BoxSyncStateDataHolder，其字段 2 是命令枚举；本项目 1 表示提供、2 表示撤回；4 表示确认、5 表示撤回确认
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: replace the three ids at the front of the snapshot's profile (pseudo device id, account Uid, network service account id). They are the console's own, handed back unchanged otherwise
zh_Hans: 替换快照 profile 开头的三个 id（伪设备 id、账号 Uid、网络服务账号 id）。它们属于实机自身，否则会原样交回
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --selection-offer, answer the console's selection status with our PK8 in field 5 (`body`) of a 40050 Data carrying OUR ownerId, on the RPC port, instead of a PokemonTradeDataHolder on 10050 port 0. Content 50's receive handler resolves the sender to a station index and drops silently when it cannot; the holder shape carries no owner
zh_Hans: 配合 --selection-offer：在 RPC 端口上用携带我们 ownerId 的 40050 Data 的第 5 个字段（`body`）放入我们的 PK8 来应答主机的选择状态，而不是在 10050 端口 0 上用 PokemonTradeDataHolder。Content 50 的接收处理程序会把发送方解析为站点索引，无法解析时静默丢弃；holder 形式不携带 owner
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send our PK8 as a Data on elementId 10000 and as a holder on the 30000-base id (30050), which every content registers. More than one variable at once
zh_Hans: 把我们的 PK8 作为 elementId 10000 上的 Data 发送，并作为 30000 基址 id（30050）上的 holder 发送，每个 content 都会注册它。可同时指定多个变量
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --selection-offer, answer the selection status with our PK8 as a PokemonTradeDataHolder on the 20000-base holder (id 20050), which is where the BOX phase's own Pokemon rides one content over. Overrides --selection-offer-mirror and --selection-offer-data
zh_Hans: 配合 --selection-offer：把我们的 PK8 作为 PokemonTradeDataHolder 放在基于 20000 的 holder（id 20050）上来应答选择状态，箱子阶段自己的宝可梦正是在它之上多一个 content 传输的。覆盖 --selection-offer-mirror 和 --selection-offer-data
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --selection-offer, answer the selection status with our PK8 in a 40050 carrying the console's OWN field set - syncId, clock, body, and neither elementId nor ownerId, which is how its own selection offer decodes. Overrides --selection-offer-data
zh_Hans: 配合 --selection-offer：把我们的 PK8 放进携带主机自身字段集的 40050 来应答选择状态 - 即 syncId、clock、body，且不含 elementId 和 ownerId，这正是它自己的选择提议被解码的方式。覆盖 --selection-offer-data
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: offer back the exact PK8 the console just offered us, unchanged, instead of one out of --send-snapshot. These bytes came out of its own save, so a run that still aborts rules the record out
zh_Hans: 原样回送实机刚提供给我们的那个 PK8，而不是从 --send-snapshot 里取一个。这些字节来自它自己的存档，所以如果运行仍然中止，就可以排除这条记录
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: put our PK8 in field 5 of the 40050 pair's second member. Content 50 is PokemonTradeDataHolder, the transfer; content 30 is the box exchange. A 344-byte PK8 rides that field
zh_Hans: 把我们的 PK8 放进 40050 对中第二个成员的字段 5。content 50 是 PokemonTradeDataHolder，即传输；content 30 是盒子交换。一个 344 字节的 PK8 就装在该字段里
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: WHEN to open the selection phase with a 40050 pair on 0x7c port 1. "offer" sends it as soon as our offer is acknowledged, the only window the console is still reading in; "migration" sends it on the migration start, after the console has stopped. The pair is the same envelope as the console's own 40030 at offset 50 with our station id; the builder reproduces its 40030 pair byte for byte
zh_Hans: 何时在 0x7c 端口 1 上用一对 40050 开始选择阶段。“offer”在我们的提供被确认后立即发送，这是主机仍在读取的唯一窗口；“migration”在迁移开始时发送，此时主机已经停止。这一对消息与主机自己的 40030 是同一个封套，位于偏移 50，并带我们的站点 id；构建器会逐字节复现它的 40030 对
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: once the migration makes us the host, broadcast UPDATE_MESH the way the console did: its own last one with the host index set to ours. The console stops sending these once it hands the role over, and the mesh is gone about 1.3 s later if nothing takes over
zh_Hans: 一旦迁移使我们成为主机，就像实机那样广播 UPDATE_MESH：用它最后发出的那条，并把主机索引设为我们的。实机在移交角色后就停止发送这些消息，如果没有任何一方接手，mesh 大约 1.3 s 后就会消失
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how often to broadcast it; the console sent one about every 2 s
zh_Hans: 多久广播一次；实机大约每 2 s 发送一次

en: how often to retransmit the migration response until it is acked
zh_Hans: 每隔多久重传迁移响应，直到被确认
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer each payload the console sends ONCE instead of re-deriving an answer to its last payload every period. `said` never clears, so without this an offer goes out hundreds of times. The console sends each of its own messages once
zh_Hans: 对控制台发送的每个载荷只应答一次，而不是每个周期都为其上一个载荷重新推导答案。`said` 从不清空，所以没有这个选项时，一个提议会发出数百次。控制台自己的每条消息只发送一次
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

zh_Hans: 四个招式 id，以逗号分隔；0 表示清空该槽位。PP 保持模板中原有的值

en: how far to advance a trade RPC's clock in our answer. 5 is nxldn-lab's and is the one number in this path nothing here has measured
zh_Hans: 我们在应答中把交换 RPC 的时钟推进多远。5 是 nxldn-lab 的值，也是这条路径上此处唯一没有实测过的数字
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after answering an RPC pair, send BOTH members again with the clock advanced by this much. The console advances its own pair's clock by 2 each burst (b41c, b61c, b81c). A repeated clock is a repeated state, so an answer that carries one clock never moves ours. 0 is off
zh_Hans: 应答一组 RPC 对之后，把时钟推进这么多再重新发送两个成员。主机会在每次突发时把自己那一对的时钟推进 2（b41c、b61c、b81c）。时钟重复就意味着状态重复，因此只带一个时钟的应答永远不会推动我们的时钟。0 表示关闭
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send our own 40050 pair the moment the console says id 130 pingSynced, before its own selection burst. nxldn-lab's client opens the selection phase this way and nothing here has ever opened one; the console sends 820000001a00 in our own captures 0.3 s before its 40050 burst
zh_Hans: 主机一报告 id 130 pingSynced 就发送我们自己的 40050 对，早于它自己的选择突发。nxldn-lab 的客户端就是这样开启选择阶段的，而这里的任何实现都从未开启过；在我们自己的抓包里，主机在其 40050 突发之前 0.3 s 发送 820000001a00
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: ACK the console's 0x84 fragments (kind 0x21, a contiguous base and a bitmask). Nothing here has ever acked this protocol, which is why the console retransmits one snapshot 19142 times and never moves on
zh_Hans: 对主机的 0x84 分片（类型 0x21，连续基址加位掩码）回 ACK。此前从未有实现确认过该协议，因此主机会把同一份快照重传 19142 次而始终不前进
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: a 3456-byte trade snapshot to send back on 0x84 once the console sends its own, or live (the default under --preset trade) for the console's own from this session. A short 2965-byte payload is inflated first. The identity is rewritten by --snapshot-name/-tid/-sid
zh_Hans: 一个 3456 字节的交换快照，在主机发送自己的快照后通过 0x84 发回；实时模式（--preset trade 下的默认）则发回本次会话中主机自己的快照。2965 字节的短负载会先解压。身份信息由 --snapshot-name/-tid/-sid 重写
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: Pia port(s) for our 0x84 messages; the console sends on 0
zh_Hans: 我们发送 0x84 消息所用的 Pia 端口；主机在端口 0 上发送
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: between our own fragments
zh_Hans: 在我们自己的分片之间

en: between whole re-sends; the console retransmits its own until acked
zh_Hans: 在整包重发之间；控制台会重传自己的消息直到被确认
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer with `pokeldn.swsh.trade.SYNC_ANSWERS` instead of echoing one payload: the ping, and the three other sync holders the console is expected to raise after the trade snapshot. A payload with no rule is REPORTED and left unanswered - that report is the point of the run
zh_Hans: 用 `pokeldn.swsh.trade.SYNC_ANSWERS` 应答，而不是回显单个载荷：ping，以及预计控制台在交换快照之后会发出的另外三个同步持有者。没有规则匹配的载荷会被报告并保持不应答 —— 该报告正是这次运行的意义
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send back whatever the console last said on this protocol, rather than the fixed --send-data. --send-data is still the first payload, before the console has said anything
zh_Hans: 回送主机在此协议上最后说的内容，而不是固定的 --send-data。--send-data 仍是第一个载荷，此时主机还没有说过任何话
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how many sequence ids of ours to send in all; 0 has no limit. One message does not hold the console's state; it sends its own heartbeat about 580 times in 180 s
zh_Hans: 总共要发送多少个我们的序列 id；0 表示不限。一条消息承载不了实机的状态；它在 180 s 内大约发送 580 次自己的心跳
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

zh_TW: 透過 IP 網路加入處於《劍》LAN 模式的主機：可填入主機位址、子網路廣播位址，或使用 auto 搜尋所有本機 /24 子網路（docs/swsh_session.md，LAN mode）；不需要無線通訊裝置或金鑰

seed: --lan：本程序的通信端口

zh_TW: --lan：主機的廣播位址；預設為 --lan 所在 /24 子網路的廣播位址

zh_TW: --lan：搜尋連線時指定的最大玩家人數；團體戰或極巨大冒險預設為 4，交換預設為 2
seed: --lan：搜索连接时指定的最大玩家人数；团体战或极巨大冒险默认为 4，交换默认为 2

seed: --lan：连续未收到主机数据多少秒后，判定主机已离开

en: the LDN scene id to seat in: 60001 a Link Trade search; any takes the first Sword network (a Max Raid den, docs/swsh_gift.md)
zh_Hans: 要加入的 LDN 场景 id：60001 为连接交换搜索；any 取第一个剑版网络（极巨团体战巢穴，docs/swsh_gift.md）

en: readings of the header byte at 0x05, in order; the IV's source id follows each one
zh_Hans: 0x05 处头字节的读数，按顺序；每个读数后面跟着 IV 的来源 id

en: per reading
zh_Hans: 每个读数
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: seconds without an update session that count as the rebroadcast stopping - the console sends ten a second, so this is fifteen missed
zh_Hans: 没有 update 会话达到多少秒就算重广播停止 - 主机每秒发送十条，所以这里是漏掉十五条
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: THE CONTROL. Ack a sequence id the console never sent: a rebroadcast that carries on under --seq-delta 1 is what attributes a stop under 0 to the ack's CONTENT rather than to our merely having transmitted
zh_Hans: 对照组。对主机从未发送过的序列号回 ACK：若在 --seq-delta 1 下重播照旧继续，就说明 0 下的停止归因于 ACK 的内容，而不是仅仅因为我们发送过 ACK
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after the ack, sweep the version-4 connection request on protocol 0x14
zh_Hans: 收到 ack 后，在协议 0x14 上扫描版本 4 的连接请求
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: values for byte [1], list or LO-HI
zh_Hans: 字节 [1] 的取值，列表或 LO-HI
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: values for byte [0x10]
zh_Hans: 字节 [0x10] 的取值
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: seconds between requests; the console answered BDSP's in 40 ms
zh_Hans: 请求之间的秒数；主机在 40 ms 内应答了 BDSP 的请求
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: values for the header byte at 0x05 on the requests, and their IV source id; list or LO-HI
zh_Hans: 请求中 0x05 处头部字节及其 IV 源 id 的取值；列表或 LO-HI
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer a connection request the CONSOLE sends us with a connection response
zh_Hans: 用连接响应应答控制台发给我们的连接请求
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: 0 is accepted
zh_Hans: 0 也可接受
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: whose constant and variable id go in the response's two id fields - a deduction, so 'both' alternates them across the retransmits
zh_Hans: 响应中两个 id 字段分别放入谁的常量 id 和变量 id——这是推断，因此 “both” 会在多次重传中交替使用两者
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: values for the platform byte at [2]. 9 is the real one; ANY other value is answered with a connection response rather than dropped, which is the probe for whether our message reaches the 0x14 handler at all
zh_Hans: [2] 处平台字节的取值。9 是真实值；任何其他值都会得到连接响应而不是被丢弃，这可用于探测我们的消息是否真的到达 0x14 处理程序
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: values for the MESSAGE flags byte. 0x09 is what the console puts on its own Local Protocol messages; BDSP's station requests carry 0x11
zh_Hans: MESSAGE 标志字节的取值。0x09 是主机在自己的 Local Protocol 消息上使用的值；BDSP 的站点请求携带 0x11
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send the requests to the console rather than the broadcast address
zh_Hans: 把请求发送给主机而不是广播地址
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send them to the broadcast address instead
zh_Hans: 改为把它们发送到广播地址
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: our own station variable id; fresh random when omitted, because a reused one is 'already one of my stations' on BDSP
zh_Hans: 我们自己的站点变量 id；省略时为新的随机值，因为在 BDSP 上复用一个会被当成“already one of my stations”
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: clear [3], which makes the console skip the variable-id comparison
zh_Hans: 清除 [3]，这会让控制台跳过变量 id 比较
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send to the console rather than the broadcast address
zh_Hans: 发送给主机而不是广播地址
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after the station handshake closes, send the Mesh Protocol (0x18) join request and ack whatever comes back
zh_Hans: 站点握手关闭后，发送 Mesh Protocol（0x18）加入请求，并对返回的任何内容回 ack
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how long to wait for the station acceptance before giving up on joining
zh_Hans: 等待站点接受多久后放弃加入
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how long to retransmit the join request; Pia's own joiner gives up at 10
zh_Hans: 重传加入请求多久；Pia 自带的加入端到 10 就放弃
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: Pia retransmits an unacknowledged join request every 500 ms
zh_Hans: Pia 每 500 毫秒重传一次未确认的加入请求
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the Pia port the join travels on; the update mesh uses the reliable one
zh_Hans: 加入流程所使用的 Pia 端口；更新网格使用可靠端口
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: byte [1]. 0xFD is what 0x017c1700 compares against; anything else is the instrument that says the handler was reached
zh_Hans: 字节 [1]。0xFD 是 0x017c1700 比较所针对的值；其他任何值都是说明已进入处理程序的标志
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: fixed ack id for the join request; random when omitted
zh_Hans: 加入请求的固定确认 id；省略时随机
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the console's 0x58 RTT requests. Sixteen bytes at version 4, and the reply echoes the seven bytes nothing has read yet
zh_Hans: 应答控制台的 0x58 RTT 请求。版本 4 下为十六字节，回复会回显那七个尚未被读取的字节
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: acknowledge the 0x7C reliable window. The pass signal is the retransmits STOPPING and the sequence ids moving on
zh_Hans: 确认 0x7C 可靠窗口。通过的信号是重传停止，并且序列号继续前进
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: which of the 32 ack slots to fill; "all" (the default) fills every one, because only the slot at some station index is read and whose index it is has not been settled. "0" is the console, "1" is us
zh_Hans: 填充 32 个 ack 槽位中的哪些；“all”（默认）会全部填充，因为只会读取某个站点索引处的槽位，而具体是哪个索引尚未确定。“0” 是主机，“1” 是我们
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the header's own 'lowest sequence pending ack'. We have sent nothing on this protocol, so 1 (the next id we would use) and 0 are both readings; the console itself sends 1 while waiting on its own first message
zh_Hans: 头部自身的“待确认的最低序列号”。我们在该协议上尚未发送任何内容，因此 1（我们将要使用的下一个 id）和 0 都说得通；主机自身在等待自己的第一条消息时发送 1
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the station BITMAP on 0x58 and 0x7C. The console sends 2 to us, station index 1; 1 is the bit for station 0, which is the console
zh_Hans: 0x58 和 0x7C 上的站点 BITMAP。主机向我们发送 2，即站点索引 1；1 是站点 0（也就是主机）的位
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send APPLICATION DATA once the mesh is up - the first of the project. The payload as hex; "610000000a00" is the six bytes the console repeats at us on 0x7C. Nothing is sent without this flag
zh_Hans: mesh 建立后发送 APPLICATION DATA - 本项目的第一次。载荷以十六进制给出；"610000000a00" 就是主机在 0x7C 上反复发给我们的六个字节。没有这个标志就什么也不发送
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: 0x80 (the broadcast reliable window, the default: it asks us for sequence 1 once a second) or 0x7c (the unicast one, which has never had an ack to send us because it has never had our data)
zh_Hans: 0x80（广播可靠窗口，默认值：它每秒向我们请求一次序列 1）或 0x7c（单播窗口，它从未有 ack 可发给我们，因为它从未收到过我们的数据）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the sequence id. 1 is what both windows ask for; the first message also carries FLAG_IS_INITIALIZED and DEFINES where the stream starts
zh_Hans: 序列 id。两个窗口都要求 1；第一条消息还会携带 FLAG_IS_INITIALIZED，并定义流的起始位置
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the stream id. 0 is what the console sends on both protocols
zh_Hans: 流 id。0 是主机在两个协议上发送的值
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the header's destination list. "console" names its station constant id, which is what its own broadcast acks do to us; "none" sends count 0, which 0x01859578 never filters and every 0x7C message carries. "auto" mirrors the console per protocol: none on 0x7C, the console on 0x80
zh_Hans: 头部的目标列表。“console” 指定其站点常量 id，即它自己的广播 ack 对我们的做法；“none” 发送计数 0，0x01859578 从不过滤该值，且每条 0x7C 消息都会携带它。“auto” 按协议镜像主机：0x7C 上为 none，0x80 上为 console
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: compress the message, the way the console compresses every 0x80 message it sends. The flag is the Pia message's (0x10 at version 4), so this is free either way - and it is one variable, so sweep it alone
zh_Hans: 压缩消息，就像控制台压缩它发送的每条 0x80 消息那样。该标志属于 Pia 消息（版本 4 下为 0x10），所以怎么选都没有代价 —— 而且它只是一个变量，所以单独扫它
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the Pia message port. The console sends its 0x80 acks on 0 AND 1, each packet carrying both; "0,1" mirrors that
zh_Hans: Pia 消息端口。主机在 0 和 1 上发送它的 0x80 ack，每个数据包同时携带两者；“0,1” 即是照此模拟
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how long to wait for the station handshake before giving up on sending
zh_Hans: 等待站点握手多久后放弃发送
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: seconds after acceptance before the first data message, so the mesh join and the RTT exchange are already running when it lands
zh_Hans: 接受之后多少秒才发第一条数据消息，这样它到达时 mesh 加入与 RTT 交换已经在进行
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: a SECOND stream, on --send2-protocol, sent once the console says --send2-trigger. `60ea000012020801` is BlockDataHolder{imReady:true}, which the console says on 0x80 and waits on
zh_Hans: 经由 --send2-protocol 的第二条流，在主机发出 --send2-trigger 后发送。`60ea000012020801` 是 BlockDataHolder{imReady:true}，主机在 0x80 上发出它并等待它
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: wait for this payload on --send2-protocol before sending; omit to send as soon as the mesh is up
zh_Hans: 发送前先在 --send2-protocol 上等待该负载；省略则在网格一建立就发送
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after our offer is acknowledged, send imReady on the TRADE holder (20030). The console has never sent these bytes and the published client waits for them before it offers, so it may be our turn to say them
zh_Hans: 我们的提供被确认后，在 TRADE holder（20030）上发送 imReady。主机从未发送过这些字节，而已发布的客户端会在提供之前等待它们，所以也许轮到我们来说
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the trade RPC on its OWN Pia port with its own reliable window. The console sends them on 0x7C port 1; an answer on port 0 lands on a window it does not read them on
zh_Hans: 在交换 RPC 自己的 Pia 端口上、用它自己的可靠窗口来应答。控制台在 0x7C 端口 1 上发送它们；在端口 0 上应答会落在它不读取它们的窗口上
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the console's MIGRATION_START on 0x18 port 1 with a MIGRATION_RESPONSE. `440001` arrives there only when the player accepts, and the console goes silent on every window afterwards: the last thing it asks for is two bytes of mesh, not application data
zh_Hans: 用 MIGRATION_RESPONSE 应答控制台在 0x18 端口 1 上的 MIGRATION_START。只有玩家接受时 `440001` 才会到达那里，而之后控制台会在所有窗口上静默：它最后请求的是两字节的 mesh，而不是应用数据
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: when the hosting console leaves, ack its update session carrying the host-migration state and leave the network on its START_HOST_MIGRATION, as its own clients do; each step waits 10 s unanswered
zh_Hans: 当主持主机离开时，对其携带主机迁移状态的更新会话进行 ack，并在其 START_HOST_MIGRATION 时离开网络，如同它自己的客户端所做；每一步在无应答时等待 10 秒
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: what to send when the console migrates the mesh. "auto" sends MIGRATION_FINISH when the start names US as the next host and a MIGRATION_RESPONSE when it names anyone else, which is what the binary says. "response" always answers 0x48, for comparison
zh_Hans: 主机迁移网格时发送的内容。“auto” 在开始消息指定我们为下一个主机时发送 MIGRATION_FINISH，指定其他任何对象时发送 MIGRATION_RESPONSE，这与二进制中的行为一致。“response” 则始终应答 0x48，用于对比
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after our offer is acknowledged, send `ping` on content N's 10000-base holder for each N - `382700000a00` for 40, which is exactly the opener nxldn-lab's client sends to start the confirmation phase, rebuilt here from our own content registry rather than copied
zh_Hans: 我们的提供被确认后，对每个 N 在 content N 的 10000 基址 holder 上发送 `ping`，例如 40 对应 `382700000a00`；这正是 nxldn-lab 的客户端用来开始确认阶段的开场消息，此处根据我们自己的 content 注册表重建，而不是照抄
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: when the CONFIRMATION envelope (40040) sends a four-byte status whose body ends `0100` - the same cue the selection content sends before its Pokemon - reply with SyncSaveDataHolder{syncCommand{data:N}} on that content's 10000-base holder, id 10040, reliable port 0, and answer the status itself on port 1. Content 40 takes a command and not a Pokemon: its parser 0x010df6d0 accepts one submessage carrying one int32. Its own machine sends 0, 1, 2 and 3 in that order (swsh_trade.SYNC_COMMANDS)
zh_Hans: 当 CONFIRMATION 信封（40040）发送主体以 `0100` 结尾的四字节状态时——这与选择内容在其宝可梦之前发送的提示相同——在该内容以 10000 为基的 holder 上、id 10040、可靠端口 0 回复 SyncSaveDataHolder{syncCommand{data:N}}，并在端口 1 上应答状态本身。内容 40 接受的是命令而不是宝可梦：其解析器 0x010df6d0 接受一条携带一个 int32 的子消息。它自身的机器按该顺序发送 0、1、2 和 3（swsh_trade.SYNC_COMMANDS）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the confirmation content's four-byte steps with phase N in the LOW u16 instead of echoing the console's own. The console reads its phase out of exactly those bytes (`0x006d6490` stores them, `0x006d3260` reads them), and every step this project has sent so far echoed the value back unchanged
zh_Hans: 用低 u16 中的阶段 N 来应答确认内容的四字节步骤，而不是回显控制台自己的值。控制台正是从这些字节读出其阶段（`0x006d6490` 存储它们，`0x006d3260` 读取它们），而本项目迄今发送的每个步骤都是把该值原样回显
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: while the confirmation ladder waits on the console, send our 40040 pair again every SECONDS with its clock advanced to the present. 0 is off
zh_TW: 交換確認流程等待主機回應時，每隔 SECONDS 秒重新傳送 pokeldn 成對的 40040 訊息，並將訊息中的時脈推進至目前時間；設為 0 可停用
seed: 交换确认流程等待主机回应时，每隔 SECONDS 秒重新传送 pokeldn 成对的 40040 信息，并将信息中的时脉推进至目前时间；设为 0 可禁用
zh_Hans: 确认阶梯等待主机回应期间，每隔 SECONDS 秒重新发送我们这对 40040 消息，并将其时钟推进到当前时间。0 表示关闭

en: once the confirmation ladder has produced its first step, end the run as soon as SECONDS pass with no NEW step body: stop transmitting, drop the link and let the console report a lost connection. Holding a stalled ladder open with acks instead makes the game declare the TRADE failed, which costs the player about an hour. Nothing but acks follows the last step body. 0 is off and the hold runs in full.
zh_Hans: 一旦确认阶梯产生了它的第一个步骤，就在 SECONDS 过去而没有新的步骤体之后立即结束本次运行：停止发送、断开连接，让实机报告连接丢失。用确认把停滞的阶梯维持住，反而会让游戏宣布交换失败，这会让玩家损失大约一小时。最后一个步骤体之后除了确认没有别的内容。0 表示关闭，此时会完整地保持等待。
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: the handshake form of --confirm-command: send the NEXT of these on each new four-byte body the confirmation content puts on elementId 20000. Content 40's own machine sends 0,1,2,3 and parks after each; one command buys two rungs and then the ladder stops
zh_Hans: --confirm-command 的握手形式：每当确认内容在 elementId 20000 上放入新的四字节主体时，依次发送这些值中的下一个。内容 40 自身的机器发送 0,1,2,3，并在每步之后停留；一条命令可推进两级，之后阶梯便停止
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after the CONFIRMATION content answers our syncCommand with a hash, re-arm the 40040 pair and send BOTH members again at this clock delta - the move --selection-final-delta makes on 40050, which carries the selection phase past its own hash
zh_Hans: CONFIRMATION content 用哈希应答我们的 syncCommand 后，重新装载 40040 这一对，并以该时钟增量再次发送两个成员，这正是 --selection-final-delta 在 40050 上所做的动作，可让选择阶段越过它自己的哈希
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after the selection HASH is answered, send the 40050 pair AGAIN - both members - at this clock delta. nxldn-lab's `selection_final_delta` is 9 (nxldn-lab's `selection_final_delta`). --rpc-pair latches per envelope, so the second pair needs the latch cleared. 0 is off
zh_Hans: 选择 HASH 被应答后，以该时钟增量再次发送 40050 对的两个成员。nxldn-lab 的 `selection_final_delta` 为 9（nxldn-lab 的 `selection_final_delta`）。--rpc-pair 按封套锁存，因此第二对需要先清除锁存。0 表示关闭
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: make --open-content send our PK8 on the 10000-base holder instead of an empty `ping`. The ping opens content 50 and is taken as our Pokemon: the console reaches the confirmation phase and asks the player to trade theirs for an egg. Same moment, same holder, a Pokemon in it
zh_Hans: 让 --open-content 在 10000 基址的 holder 上发送我们的 PK8，而不是空的 `ping`。ping 会打开 content 50 并被当作我们的宝可梦：实机因此进入确认阶段，并要求玩家用他们的宝可梦换一颗蛋。同一时刻、同一 holder，里面放一只宝可梦
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send these box commands the moment MIGRATION_START arrives - the only signal that says the player pressed accept. The console keeps acking for about five seconds after it
zh_Hans: MIGRATION_START 一到就发送这些 box 命令 - 这是唯一表示玩家按下接受的信号。主机在此之后还会持续确认约五秒
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: seconds between the queued post-offer payloads. Spread them so the sweep spans the accept: the console tears down on the accept, not on a timer, so commands sent inside a couple of seconds all land before it
zh_Hans: 排队的 offer 后载荷之间的秒数。把它们拉开，让轮扫覆盖到接受：主机是在接受时才拆除，而不是靠计时器，因此几秒内发出的命令都会在拆除前到达
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: when the console follows its selection-phase Pokemon with the status whose body ends `0100`, offer OUR Pokemon on that content's 10000-base holder (id 10050) on reliable port 0 and answer the status on port 1
zh_Hans: 当主机在选择阶段宝可梦之后跟随主体以 `0100` 结尾的状态时，在该内容以 10000 为基的 holder（id 10050）上、可靠端口 0 提供我们的宝可梦，并在端口 1 上应答该状态
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: once a hash body has been answered, open content N's phase by sending the two-member RPC pair for it (40 is the confirmation). A pair is the only shape that opens a phase on this console: 40030 opened the offer and 40050 the selection. A bare content ping (`382700000a00`) and a bare sync-120 ping (`780000000a00`) are both ignored
zh_Hans: hash 体应答之后，发送针对它的双成员 RPC 对来打开 content N 的阶段（40 是确认）。在这台实机上，只有成对的形式才能打开一个阶段：40030 打开了提供，40050 打开了选择。单纯的内容 ping（`382700000a00`）和单纯的 sync-120 ping（`780000000a00`）都会被忽略
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: queue a sync on holder N right behind our selection offer, in the branch that actually runs when --selection-offer is on. --sync-after-hash cannot fire there: this one can
zh_Hans: 把 holder N 上的 sync 紧跟在我们的选择提供之后排队，放在 --selection-offer 打开时真正执行的那条分支里。--sync-after-hash 在那里无法触发：这个可以
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: which SyncPingDataHolder field --sync-after-hash sends: 1 ping, 2 pingReply, 3 pingSynced (`780000001a00`, the one the trace records)
zh_Hans: --sync-after-hash 发送哪个 SyncPingDataHolder 字段：1 ping、2 pingReply、3 pingSynced（`780000001a00`，即跟踪记录中的那个）
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: once a hash body has been answered, send `ping` on sync holder N (120 is the confirmation's) on port 0. The console drives 97, 60000, 110 and 130 itself and opens the selection phase when 130's pingSynced lands; it never sends 120. A phase follows its sync, not a content ping
zh_Hans: hash 体应答之后，在端口 0 上对 sync holder N 发送 `ping`（120 是确认用的那个）。实机会自己驱动 97、60000、110 和 130，并在 130 的 pingSynced 到达时打开选择阶段；它从不发送 120。阶段跟随的是它的 sync，而不是内容 ping
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: once a hash body has been answered, `ping` content N's 10000-base holder on port 0 to open the next phase - 40 is the confirmation, so this sends `382700000a00`. The console stops sending 40050 once the hash answer lands and says nothing further; Pia retransmits anything it still waits on, so that silence means satisfied and the next phase needs opening
zh_Hans: hash 体应答之后，在端口 0 上对 content N 的 10000 基址 holder 执行 `ping` 以打开下一阶段——40 就是确认，因此这会发送 `382700000a00`。hash 应答到达后，实机就停止发送 40050 且不再多说什么；Pia 会重传它仍在等待的一切，所以这种静默意味着已满足，下一阶段需要主动打开
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer every DISTINCT (envelope, base, field-5 body) in the 40000 band once, on top of the opening pair. The clock advances on every message so the payload cannot be the key, but the body can: `00000000` and `000018fc` are the openers and anything else is new. A per-envelope guard stops answering at the hash body and stalls there
zh_Hans: 对 40000 频段内每个不同的 (envelope, base, field-5 body) 只应答一次，此外还覆盖开局的那一对。每条消息的时钟都会前进，所以载荷不能当作键，但消息体可以：`00000000` 和 `000018fc` 是开局消息，其他任何值都是新的。按 envelope 设置的守卫会在哈希体处停止应答并卡在那里
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer the console's 40030 RPC as the PAIR it is: collect both members one per base, 10000 then 20000, keyed on the BASE FIELD. `payload[5] in (0x19, 0x1A)` is the inner length and moves with the sender's station-id varint (0x1A/0x1B on some consoles). Send both once in that order and nothing more on this window; `said_by_port` keeps only the last payload, so a mirror sends one member repeatedly and never the other
zh_Hans: 把控制台的 40030 RPC 当作它本来的一对来应答：每个 base 收集一个成员，先 10000 后 20000，以 BASE 字段为键。`payload[5] in (0x19, 0x1A)` 是内层长度，并随发送方的 station-id varint 变化（某些控制台上是 0x1A/0x1B）。按该顺序各发送一次，此窗口内不再发送其他内容；`said_by_port` 只保留最后一个载荷，所以镜像会反复发送其中一个成员，永远不发另一个
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: `ping` content N's 10000-base holder at the 0x84 snapshot ack, before either side offers. The console's box send is gated on a ready bool at content+0x4c that only `0x010ce040` sets, on a zero result code; until then every command the game tries to send is parked in content+0x48. A parked command that does not match the next one sets the error byte +0x4d, and `0x010c9bb0` turns that into trade state 9: abort, with nothing on the application layer
zh_Hans: 在 0x84 快照 ack 时、双方都尚未发起提供之前，对 content N 的 10000 基址 holder 执行 `ping`。主机的盒子发送受 content+0x4c 处的一个 ready 布尔值控制，只有 `0x010ce040` 在结果码为 0 时会设置它；在此之前，游戏尝试发送的每条命令都停在 content+0x48。停下的命令若与下一条不匹配，就会置位错误字节 +0x4d，而 `0x010c9bb0` 会把它变成交换状态 9：中止，应用层上没有任何提示
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send these box commands as soon as the console acks our 0x84 snapshot - BEFORE either side offers a Pokemon. The game sends command 3 exactly once, on the first frame after its trade session is built and only when the role bit at session+0x419 is clear (0x010c9bb0), so one of the two sides owes the other an opener before anything else happens. Sent after both offers instead, the console leaves while the player is still picking
zh_Hans: 主机一确认我们的 0x84 快照就发送这些 box 命令 - 早于任一方提供宝可梦。游戏只在交换会话建立后的第一帧、且 session+0x419 处的角色位为 clear（0x010c9bb0）时发送一次命令 3，因此两方中总有一方要在其他事情发生前先给开场。若改为在双方都 offer 之后才发送，主机会在玩家还在挑选时就离开
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: after our offer is acknowledged, send boxSyncStateCommand{data:N} on the trade holder for each N in turn, one per acknowledged sequence. 20030 is a BoxSyncStateDataHolder and its field 2 is a command enum; this project 1 offers and 2 withdraws; 4 confirms and 5 withdraws the confirmation
zh_Hans: 我们的提供被确认后，依次对每个 N 在 trade holder 上发送 boxSyncStateCommand{data:N}，每个已确认的序列发一条。20030 是 BoxSyncStateDataHolder，其字段 2 是命令枚举；本项目 1 表示提供、2 表示撤回；4 表示确认、5 表示撤回确认
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: replace the three ids at the front of the snapshot's profile (pseudo device id, account Uid, network service account id). They are the console's own, handed back unchanged otherwise
zh_Hans: 替换快照 profile 开头的三个 id（伪设备 id、账号 Uid、网络服务账号 id）。它们属于实机自身，否则会原样交回
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --selection-offer, answer the console's selection status with our PK8 in field 5 (`body`) of a 40050 Data carrying OUR ownerId, on the RPC port, instead of a PokemonTradeDataHolder on 10050 port 0. Content 50's receive handler resolves the sender to a station index and drops silently when it cannot; the holder shape carries no owner
zh_Hans: 配合 --selection-offer：在 RPC 端口上用携带我们 ownerId 的 40050 Data 的第 5 个字段（`body`）放入我们的 PK8 来应答主机的选择状态，而不是在 10050 端口 0 上用 PokemonTradeDataHolder。Content 50 的接收处理程序会把发送方解析为站点索引，无法解析时静默丢弃；holder 形式不携带 owner
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: send our PK8 as a Data on elementId 10000 and as a holder on the 30000-base id (30050), which every content registers. More than one variable at once
zh_Hans: 把我们的 PK8 作为 elementId 10000 上的 Data 发送，并作为 30000 基址 id（30050）上的 holder 发送，每个 content 都会注册它。可同时指定多个变量
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --selection-offer, answer the selection status with our PK8 as a PokemonTradeDataHolder on the 20000-base holder (id 20050), which is where the BOX phase's own Pokemon rides one content over. Overrides --selection-offer-mirror and --selection-offer-data
zh_Hans: 配合 --selection-offer：把我们的 PK8 作为 PokemonTradeDataHolder 放在基于 20000 的 holder（id 20050）上来应答选择状态，箱子阶段自己的宝可梦正是在它之上多一个 content 传输的。覆盖 --selection-offer-mirror 和 --selection-offer-data
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: with --selection-offer, answer the selection status with our PK8 in a 40050 carrying the console's OWN field set - syncId, clock, body, and neither elementId nor ownerId, which is how its own selection offer decodes. Overrides --selection-offer-data
zh_Hans: 配合 --selection-offer：把我们的 PK8 放进携带主机自身字段集的 40050 来应答选择状态 - 即 syncId、clock、body，且不含 elementId 和 ownerId，这正是它自己的选择提议被解码的方式。覆盖 --selection-offer-data
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: offer back the exact PK8 the console just offered us, unchanged, instead of one out of --send-snapshot. These bytes came out of its own save, so a run that still aborts rules the record out
zh_Hans: 原样回送实机刚提供给我们的那个 PK8，而不是从 --send-snapshot 里取一个。这些字节来自它自己的存档，所以如果运行仍然中止，就可以排除这条记录
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: put our PK8 in field 5 of the 40050 pair's second member. Content 50 is PokemonTradeDataHolder, the transfer; content 30 is the box exchange. A 344-byte PK8 rides that field
zh_Hans: 把我们的 PK8 放进 40050 对中第二个成员的字段 5。content 50 是 PokemonTradeDataHolder，即传输；content 30 是盒子交换。一个 344 字节的 PK8 就装在该字段里
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: WHEN to open the selection phase with a 40050 pair on 0x7c port 1. "offer" sends it as soon as our offer is acknowledged, the only window the console is still reading in; "migration" sends it on the migration start, after the console has stopped. The pair is the same envelope as the console's own 40030 at offset 50 with our station id; the builder reproduces its 40030 pair byte for byte
zh_Hans: 何时在 0x7c 端口 1 上用一对 40050 开始选择阶段。“offer”在我们的提供被确认后立即发送，这是主机仍在读取的唯一窗口；“migration”在迁移开始时发送，此时主机已经停止。这一对消息与主机自己的 40030 是同一个封套，位于偏移 50，并带我们的站点 id；构建器会逐字节复现它的 40030 对
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: once the migration makes us the host, broadcast UPDATE_MESH the way the console did: its own last one with the host index set to ours. The console stops sending these once it hands the role over, and the mesh is gone about 1.3 s later if nothing takes over
zh_Hans: 一旦迁移使我们成为主机，就像实机那样广播 UPDATE_MESH：用它最后发出的那条，并把主机索引设为我们的。实机在移交角色后就停止发送这些消息，如果没有任何一方接手，mesh 大约 1.3 s 后就会消失
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how often to broadcast it; the console sent one about every 2 s
zh_Hans: 多久广播一次；实机大约每 2 s 发送一次
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: how often to retransmit the migration response until it is acked
zh_Hans: 每隔多久重传迁移响应，直到被确认
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: answer each payload the console sends ONCE instead of re-deriving an answer to its last payload every period. `said` never clears, so without this an offer goes out hundreds of times. The console sends each of its own messages once
zh_Hans: 对控制台发送的每个载荷只应答一次，而不是每个周期都为其上一个载荷重新推导答案。`said` 从不清空，所以没有这个选项时，一个提议会发出数百次。控制台自己的每条消息只发送一次
notes: 繁中参考未覆盖，需从英文翻译

en: which party slot of --send-snapshot to offer back, 1-6; 0 offers nothing and only records what the console offers us
zh_TW: 要換回的 --send-snapshot 同行寶可夢位置，範圍 1-6；0 表示不提供寶可夢，只記錄主機提供的內容
seed: 要换回的 --send-snapshot 同行宝可梦位置，范围 1-6；0 表示不提供宝可梦，只记录主机提供的内容
zh_Hans: 回赠 --send-snapshot 的哪个队伍槽位，1-6；0 表示不提供任何内容，只记录主机提供给我们的内容

en: a .pk8 to put in --offer-slot in place of the snapshot's record: stored or party form, encrypted or PKHeX's decrypted export. Its OT name and ids become the snapshot's unless --offer-file-as-is. Repeatable, one per trade on the session: the console's player picks again from the box; the last serves every later trade
zh_TW: 以 .pk8 取代快照中 --offer-slot 的資料，可為盒子或同行格式、加密檔或 PKHeX 解密匯出檔。除非指定 --offer-file-as-is，否則會使用快照的初訓家名稱與 ID。可重複指定，依序用於各次交換；玩家需從盒子再次選擇，後續交換持續使用最後一筆
seed: 以 .pk8 取代快照中 --offer-slot 的数据，可为盒子或同行格式、加密档或 PKHeX 解密导出档。除非指定 --offer-file-as-is，否则会使用快照的初训家名称与 ID。可重复指定，依序用于各次交换；玩家需从盒子再次选择，后续交换持续使用最后一笔
